**Sr. Electrical Engineer**

**McCoy Global**

**THIS JOB IS FOR YOU**

**IF YOU** ACT LIKE AN OWNER AND OWN YOUR ACTIONS;

**IF YOU** EMBRACE CHALLENGE AND LEAD CHANGE;

**IF YOU** EVOLVE, ADAPT AND CELEBRATE SUCCESS;

**IF YOU** APPROACH ALL INTERACTIONS POSTIVELY, COURAGEOULSY AND HONESTLY;

**IF YOU** HAVE YOUR TEAMS BACK;

**IF YOU** ARE THE BEST AT EVERYTHING YOU DO!

**What We Need:**

Are you passionate about designing intelligent industrial products that solve real-world challenges? We are seeking an experienced **Senior Electrical Engineer** to lead the design, development, and testing of embedded systems that power our next generation of industrial sensors and control solutions.

In this role, you will take ownership of products throughout the entire development lifecycle, from concept and prototyping through validation, certification, and production release. You will combine deep expertise in embedded hardware and firmware development with strong leadership skills to drive cross-functional projects and deliver reliable, high-performance systems that operate safely and efficiently in demanding industrial environments.

The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in embedded control systems, advanced C/C++ programming, electronic circuit design, and industrial communications. If you enjoy solving complex technical problems, mentoring teams, and transforming innovative ideas into robust commercial products, we want to hear from you.

**What you’ll bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 10+ years of hands-on experience in embedded systems development.

**What you’ll do:**

* Proven experience developing embedded control systems for industrial equipment.
* Advanced C and C++ for embedded applications, with production firmware experience across a range of embedded platforms.
* Strong embedded software architecture skills: state machines, device drivers, and code structure that holds up as a product grows.
* Proficient with microcontroller and microprocessor platforms across multiple architectures, including part selection.
* Solid working knowledge of hardware interfaces and peripherals.
* Practical experience with industrial communication protocols.
* Solid electronic circuit design capability, including power and signal design.
* Expert use of lab and debugging equipment to resolve complex hardware and software issues.
* Ability to lead cross functional projects, and drive planning, code reviews, and design for certification.

**Who Are We?**

Over a century ago, blacksmith Henry McCoy established the Edmonton Auto Spring Works in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. Back in 1914, the name McCoy meant a commitment to quality; and that, along with a desire to continually innovate, is what we stand for today.

**KEEPING AHEAD OF THE CURVE**

Always ahead of the curve, we’ve evolved from auto springs, axle manufacturing, trucking, and trailers, to hydraulic power tongs, advanced engineering for wellbore integrity, data acquisition for harsh environments, and cloud-based automated Smart technology solutions. **LEADING CHANGE**

All along the way, we have aggressively embraced change to support our customers at every turn, anticipating their needs and delivering highly customized solutions. It is no surprise that our company today bears little resemblance to the blacksmith shop of 1914.

**AN UNWAVERING FOCUS**

Yet it is also no surprise that our spirit remains fundamentally unchanged: our focus on quality and customization ensures the products and services we provide live up to our promises, so you can live up to yours.

**When you work at McCoy, you work with:**

* A great teamwork environment that challenges your ability while having fun.
* A voice to help us continuously improve our processes and teams.
* A chance to help us deliver innovative solutions to our customers provide energy to the world.
* An opportunity to grow within our company as we succeed in growing our customers.
* An organization that recognizes and cares about its employee’s well-being.

**So, what can McCoy offer you?**

* We offer competitive time-off
* 4 wellness days PER YEAR plus your birthday off!
* 3 weeks of vacation accrued throughout the year
* We match your 401K
* Matching Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Work with a company that CARES

**We are 1-McCoy and We want YOU!**

Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. That same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices, strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it! Most software engineering roles hand off testing to one team and operations to another. Here you own all of it. As a Software Engineer on Forge, you'll design, build, test, ship, and run the platform Apple's engineering teams build on, working closely with those teams to find where the infrastructure beneath them gets in the way and fixing it. Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) is part of IS&T and delivers global-scale platforms and services that keep Apple's operations secure and running. The team manages identity, device security, and anti-abuse platforms — covering everything from manufacturing and repairs to software updates and activations. ETS also oversees supply chain, manufacturing, and partner integration platforms, protecting data on more than 2.5 billion devices worldwide. And when Apple prepares for a global product launch, ETS owns the systems that ramp factory production — managing serial numbers, network credentials, and verified software.

* 1+ years experience in APIs and HTTP(S) and RESTful architectures.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related engineer degree.

* Skilled in designing and developing distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Experience building mobile-responsive web applications, with a focus on cross-browser compatibility.
* Well-versed in software engineering best practices, including design patterns and enterprise architecture.
* Experience in ReactJS, TypeScript, and web development toolchains including Webpack and Jest.

jobs.title: Senior Control Systems Engineer (ABB)

This includes the leadership of the migration and lifecycle system process, maintenance recommendation and oversight of installed base equipment, co-ordination of concepts with production.

* Health and Safety is our #1 priority and we live it 3-6-5!
* Competitive pay and benefits
* Comprehensive health benefits coverage after 30 days
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Group 401-K retirement savings with company matching

* Positive and safe work environments

* Lead safety, environmental compliance, and management of change (MOC) activities for all automation and control system modifications.

* Monitor system health, execute preventive maintenance strategies, and resolve issues proactively to minimize downtime and operational risk.
* Develop, implement, and optimize control strategies, logic, alarms, interlocks, graphics, sequencing, loop tuning, and advanced process control applications.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and technical support for control systems, OT networks, instrumentation, hardware, software, and cybersecurity-related issues.

* Manage control system assets, critical spares, vendor relationships, service agreements, and total cost of ownership to maximize business value.
* Maintain secure OT infrastructure, including backups, disaster recovery, remote access, patch management, network administration, and cybersecurity compliance.
* Maintain accurate technical documentation, including P&IDs, loop drawings, control narratives, logic records, I/O databases, network diagrams, and system architecture documents.
* Lead root cause analyses and continuous improvement initiatives to improve reliability, safety, and operational performance.
* Support capital projects, outages, turnarounds, FAT/SAT testing, commissioning, startup, and contractor/vendor management activities.
* Drive standardization, best practices, performance metrics, dashboards, and configuration quality across all supported facilities.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, training, regional support, and on-call assistance as required.

**Control Systems and Technical Scope**

* ABB 800xA and/or INFI 90/Symphony (Essential) with hands-on experience in configuration, diagnostics, lifecycle management, system administration, and architecture design.
* Emerson DeltaV and Rockwell Automation (Highly Desired) including DeltaV, ControlLogix, Studio 5000, FactoryTalk, communications infrastructure, troubleshooting, and lifecycle support.
* SCADA, HMI, and Historian Platforms including AVEVA/Wonderware, Canary Historian, and related industrial data management systems.
* Industrial Networks and Communications including TCP/IP, OPC, Modbus, Profibus, FOUNDATION Fieldbus, EtherNet/IP, wireless technologies, and secure remote access solutions.
* Control System Infrastructure and Cybersecurity including process control networks, servers, workstations, managed switches, domain services, virtualization platforms (VMware), system backups, disaster recovery, and OT cybersecurity best practices.
* Process Control and Functional Safety including alarm management, DCS interlocks, SIS lifecycle management, loop tuning, sequence control, basic and advanced process control, and process optimization initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Mandatory ABB experience combined with either Emerson DeltaV or Rockwell Automation experience, with preference given to candidates who possess ABB plus DeltaV expertise, or ABB plus Rockwell ControlLogix / FactoryTalk expertise.
* ABB, Emerson, or Rockwell automation training, certifications, and experience with industrial networking standards, virtualization platforms, and control system infrastructure.
* Experience supporting SIS lifecycle management, functional safety programs, alarm management, OT cybersecurity initiatives, and recognized standards such as ISA/IEC 62443, NIST, and CISA guidance.

**Travel and Work Location Expectations**

* The position is based at the Deer Park Incineration Site in Texas or Utah
* Approximately 25% travel is expected.
* Aragonite support is expected monthly, typically 4 to 5 days per trip.
* Kimball, El Dorado, and Sarnia each have two planned outages per year; travel is expected for these outages and may be required for other critical support needs.
* Additional travel may be required for emergencies, projects, commissioning, training, system migrations, vendor activities, or business priorities.

  + Ensure manufacturing risks and maturation plans are visible in the program risk register and to Sentinel leadership.
* Lead Design for Manufacturing & Assembly (DFMA) and producibility analysis for Sentinel:
  + Integrate DFMA across Systems Engineering, Design Engineering, Global Supply Chain, suppliers, and operations.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

The semiconductor industry is experiencing one of the largest periods of growth and transformation in its history, and Tool Install design sits at the center of it. At SSOE, we design systems that connect some of the world's most advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment to the facilities that power tomorrow's technologies. From tool hookups and utility systems to subfab design, cleanroom modifications, and equipment integration, our work directly impacts the production of next-generation chips used in AI, data centers, autonomous vehicles, consumer electronics, and advanced computing. Recognized as one of the industry's leading semiconductor design firms, SSOE combines deep technical expertise with a culture built on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Here, you'll work alongside some of the brightest minds in engineering, leverage cutting-edge digital and AI-enabled tools, and contribute to projects that are shaping the future of technology. If you're looking for meaningful work, technical challenges, and a place where your ideas matter, you'll find it at SSOE.

As an **Electrical Engineer** at SSOE, you'll work alongside experienced engineers, project managers, and multidisciplinary design teams to develop electrical designs for tool installations, power distribution, cleanroom environments, and facility upgrades that enable next-generation technology manufacturing. In this role, you will be involved in electrical calculations, focusing on low to medium voltage environments. The ideal candidate possesses experience with distribution panel loading, short circuit analysis, voltage drop calculations, conduit and conductor sizing, and cable tray fills. You will have access to industry-leading tools, collaborative leadership, and a firm culture consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work. Join us in shaping innovative design-build projects with a relentless commitment to quality, efficiency, and collaborative excellence.

AI and Innovation:

At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows.

Responsibilities:

* Generate comprehensive technical project plans, specifications, drawings, and models aligned with both industry standards, client requirements, and electrical engineering best practices.
* Develop detailed electrical drawings and technical documentation that support areas such as process equipment installation design packages, tool hookup design, subfab rack and lateral design, and cleanroom and facility modification support.
* Determine conduit and conductor sizing, meticulously accounting for current loads and environmental variables.
* Assess cable tray fills methodically to guarantee proper cable management, organization, and future scalability.
* Perform detailed short circuit calculations to accurately determine fault currents, select appropriate protective devices, and ensure system safety.
* Perform precise voltage drop calculations to ensure electrical system stability and compliance with industry standards.
* Ensure all electrical designs rigorously comply with and exceed local, state, and national electrical codes and regulations to guarantee safety and quality.
* Apply established design techniques and exercises discernment in adapting and modifying design concepts as needed. Uphold quality control by adhering to company and team design and CAD standards.
* Will work with Sr. Engineers, Project Managers, and other stakeholders on specific assigned objectives, complex features, and aid in deriving possible solutions to unusual problems.
* Foster collaboration, communication, strategy, and support within your team, multidisciplinary groups (Mechanical, Structural, Process/Chemical, Architectural, etc.), and inter-company teams to optimize efficiency, quality, and resource allocation.
* Conduct field verifications and site walks to identify, validate, resolve, and integrate solutions into design packages. Resolve design issues on-site during construction if necessary.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering from an ABET-accredited institution, qualifying candidate for professional engineering licensure in Arizona.
* Successful completion of the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE/EIT) exam, with a focus on electrical engineering principles, is highly desired.
* Demonstrated proficiency in AutoCAD for electrical design drafting is required. Experience with other tools such as Revit, ETAP, SKM Power Tools, and/or EasyPower is a plus.
* Knowledge of electrical codes and standards (e.g., National Electric Code, NFPA, etc.).
* Ability to clearly communicate technical information and design concepts to project managers, contractors, and cross-disciplinary teams.
* Salary Range: $68,000 - $98,000/year depending on location, education, experience, and any certifications that are directly related to the position.

Join us at SSOE, where your expertise will thrive in a dynamic and collaborative environment. SSOE doesn't just hire talent, we invest in it. If you're passionate about innovation, career progression, and eager to make a significant impact, we invite you to apply and become a part of our forward-thinking team.

jobs.title: Global Production Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking an experienced Production Systems Engineer to join the Data Center Operations team. Our data centers and the tens of thousands of servers installed within them form the foundation upon which Meta's rapidly scaling infrastructure operates and upon which innovative services are delivered. Meta is at the leading edge of the global data center industry in both design and operations. This role requires a forward-thinking systems professional with deep experience leveraging diverse software tools to identify automation solutions for complex operational challenges. The ideal candidate performs deep data analysis to prioritize server repair automation in a hyperscale environment, drives solutions through code, and collaborates effectively with globally distributed teams through clear written communication.  
  
  

### **Global Production Systems Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Identify and root cause systemic issues across the server fleet and drive resolutions to maximize uptime and utilization by leveraging hardware failure data and diagnostic telemetry
* Write, review, and maintain code for diagnostic and automation tooling that supports quality and efficient delivery of production servers at hyperscale
* Own and develop diagnostic tooling requirements that enable frontline operations teams to efficiently manage and repair the server fleet
* Drive the escalation process for Data Center Operations to identify, root cause, and resolve complex tooling and hardware issues affecting fleet health
* Execute operational validation and verification activities for new product integration into the production environment
* Collaborate with cross-functional tooling teams to provide an operations-centric perspective on open issues and contribute to their development roadmaps
* Perform deep data analysis to prioritize automation opportunities for server repair workflows in a large-scale, heterogeneous hardware environment
* Build cross-functional relationships and influence policies and procedures to improve global data center operations consistency and efficiency
* Mentor other engineers on evaluating and resolving fleet issues and defining improvements to tools and operational processes
* Travel up to 25% to support global data center operations and new site deployments

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 6+ years of experience in production systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or systems software development for large-scale hardware environments
* 6+ years of experience with hardware lifecycle management, fleet automation, or data center operations systems spanning compute, storage, or networking infrastructure
* Experience developing systems software or automation tooling in Python, Bash, PHP, C, or C++ for Linux-based production environments at scale
* Experience with configuration and maintenance of production systems including web servers, load balancers, relational databases, storage systems, and messaging systems
* Experience communicating technical designs and infrastructure decisions through written documentation and cross-functional stakeholder alignment across engineering and operations teams

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing or operating configuration management and infrastructure-as-code systems for large heterogeneous hardware fleets
* Experience supporting global, multi-site data center infrastructure deployments including hardware qualification and regional rollout coordination
* Experience with data analysis and visualization tools used to prioritize fleet health initiatives and drive operational decision-making

If you’re ready for high‑voltage challenges and high‑visibility impact, this is your next step.

jobs.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.

Our team develops foundational firmware infrastructure, frameworks, and platform services for Microsoft's cloud hardware, AI infrastructure, and custom silicon platforms. We build shared firmware components, low-level platform services, and reusable frameworks that accelerate platform readiness and improve reliability across hardware programs and silicon generations.

We are seeking a **Senior Firmware Engineer** with experience with firmware development and Rust experience to develop and debug shared firmware components, support platform bring-up, and improve firmware reliability, security, and maintainability.

#SCHIE

 **Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, debug, and maintain shared firmware components and platform services in Rust and C/C++ for Microsoft's cloud hardware and custom silicon programs.

* Develop reusable firmware frameworks, libraries, hardware abstraction layers, device drivers, and common services, with attention to memory management, resource constraints, reliability, and performance.

* Implement and review Rust code independently, applying ownership and borrowing principles, memory-safe interfaces, and careful handling of unsafe code and interoperability with existing C/C++ firmware.

* Support early firmware development, integration, and validation through pre-silicon environments, simulation, FPGA prototyping, and hardware bring-up; diagnose issues across firmware, drivers, and hardware interfaces.

* Develop platform services, telemetry, diagnostics, and reliability capabilities, and apply secure engineering practices throughout design, implementation, review, and testing.

* Collaborate with silicon, hardware, platform, validation, and software engineering teams to define requirements, document interfaces, resolve technical issues, and deliver reusable firmware across programs.

* Develop and maintain unit, integration, and regression tests; investigate failures and root causes; and improve test effectiveness and firmware quality.

* Contribute technical leadership through design and code reviews, debugging, mentorship, and sharing practical Rust and firmware engineering knowledge.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

Doctorate in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 1+ year(s) technical engineering experience OR Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 5+ years technical engineering experience OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to, the following specialized security screening: Microsoft Cloud Background Check. This position is required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate’s citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing firmware for complex hardware, server-class systems, datacenter platforms, or AI accelerators.

* Experience with SoC bring-up, bootloaders, board support packages, hardware abstraction layers, device drivers, or hardware interfaces such as I2C/I3C, SPI, UART, or PCIe.

* Experience integrating Rust into established embedded codebases, including Rust/C/C++ interoperability, foreign-function interfaces, or resource-constrained and no\_std environments.

* Experience with secure firmware, secure boot, threat modeling, or related secure-development practices.

* Experience with platform management, serviceability, telemetry, diagnostics, firmware update, or reliability capabilities, including technologies such as PLDM, MCTP, or Redfish.

jobs.description:
We are seeking an entry level Mechatronics Engineer to support the design, integration, testing, and maintenance of automation and control systems for custom laboratory equipment and robotic platforms at Novex. Recent graduates, Engineer-in-Training (EIT) candidates, and applicants with relevant technical training or equivalent practical experience are encouraged to apply.

This role combines mechanical design, electrical and controls integration, programming, and hands-on prototyping. Projects include instrumenting experimental setups, connecting sensors to PLCs and data acquisition systems, developing operator interfaces, and supporting automated liquid and material handling.

Working with our R&D team, you will contribute to projects from initial design through assembly, testing, and commissioning. You will also help maintain existing robotic platforms and develop custom equipment for future research needs. The position is based at our facility in Bellingham, WA, and suits someone who learns quickly, follows through on assigned work, and adapts as experimental requirements evolve.

**Why join us?**
----------------

* **Work on meaningful scientific and engineering challenges.** Develop automation for experimental systems used in chemical and materials research. See how equipment design and control decisions affect the quality and reliability of laboratory work.
* **Put advanced equipment to work.** Work with laboratory automation and robotic platforms from Chemspeed, Hamilton, Sirius Automation, ABB, and FESTO, alongside analytical instruments and custom experimental equipment.
* **Keep learning and growing.** Build skills in controls, robotics, mechanical design, and prototyping through practical projects, technical guidance, and training. Take on increasing responsibility as your capabilities develop.
* **Enjoy flexibility and professional development.** Benefit from flexible work arrangements that accommodate laboratory and project needs, along with opportunities to develop your technical skills and advance your career.
* **Make an impact in a growing team.** Contribute ideas and help turn experimental requirements into working hardware. Projects offer varied assignments across equipment development, integration, and improvement.
* **Live and work between the mountains and the sea.** Bellingham, Washington, offers access to skiing at Mount Baker, sailing in the San Juan Islands, and hiking through Pacific Northwest forests, with Seattle and Vancouver, BC, within reach.

* **Instrumentation and controls:** Sensors, process monitoring, data acquisition, and controls integration for custom laboratory and pilot equipment.
* **Mechanical design and prototyping:** CAD, 3D printing, fabrication, and assembly of fixtures, tooling, and prototype components.
* **Laboratory and pilot equipment:** Reactors, thermal equipment, electrochemical systems, and experimental test rigs.

* Working familiarity with CAD for designing or modifying parts, gained through coursework or practical projects.
* A systematic approach to troubleshooting, accurate documentation, and safe equipment assembly and testing.
* Dependable work habits, clear communication, and the ability to learn unfamiliar tools and adapt to changing project priorities while collaborating with the team.

* Experience with industrial PLCs, including Allen-Bradley/Rockwell or Siemens, and with HMIs, variable frequency

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager – AI/ML Hardware Engineering, Edge & AI/ML Accelerator Team
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS operates the world's largest fleet of GPU-accelerated servers powering AI/ML workloads at cloud scale. Our team designs, builds, and operates this fleet — solving systemic hardware issues and building systems that detect and prevent recurrence so customers experience the highest quality of service.  
  
We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager (hardware) to drive end-to-end delivery of GPU-accelerated servers across our global fleet. You will coordinate cross-functional engineering teams spanning hardware, firmware, and software, manage ODM partnerships across multiple continents, and establish closed-loop quality systems that drive continuous improvements. This role requires technical depth to translate engineering constraints into program risk, combined with program management excellence to deliver complex hardware at global scale.  
  
What You Will Do  
You will own programs where the critical path runs through silicon, firmware, and software teams simultaneously. You will translate ambiguity into structure: turning a fleet telemetry signal into a corrective action plan with quantified failure rates, a customer requirement into a new platform milestone with EVT/DVT/PVT gates, or a manufacturing escape into a design change with updated validation criteria. You will drive decisions on program trade-offs — adjusting scope when qualification gates slip, balancing deployment speed against fleet risk, and determining when to accept interim mitigations instead of holding for root-cause fixes. When a large scale of GPU servers depend on your program landing on time, you are the one ensuring hardware readiness, qualification completeness, and operational handoff happen without gaps.  
  
Why You Will Love It  
The world's most advanced frontier models are trained on the platforms you help build. Your programs launch the GPU servers that power the largest AI/ML workloads on the planet. You will see your decisions reflected in fleet reliability metrics within weeks of deployment. The team is small and high-trust — you own programs end to end from concept through production, with direct access to leadership and engineering alike.  
  
The Ideal Candidate  
You have deep technical intuition across hardware and software — enough to challenge engineering decisions, not just track them. You thrive in ambiguity, bringing structure to programs where requirements, timelines, and dependencies are still forming. You align priorities across teams in different organizations, and you escalate with data, not noise. You actively mentor and develop others — TPMs and engineers alike. You contribute to hiring, promotion assessments, and raising the bar for program management practices in your organization.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Strategy & Mechanisms  
  

* Define program strategy, objectives, and success criteria; influence resource allocation and priority decisions across engineering workstreams to align with organizational goals
* Build and own mechanisms for program visibility — defining metrics, dashboards, and review cadences that enable data-driven decisions and early risk detection
* Streamline delivery processes across teams; identify and eliminate dependencies, redundant gates, or coordination overhead that slow velocity

  
Requirements & Planning  
  

* Facilitate requirements gathering with internal customers; develop Technical Requirements Documents (TRDs) covering server specs, rack configurations, PCIe topology, power/cooling topology, and SKU definitions
* Build program timelines aligned to different phases (Program Initiation, Design, Qualification, Pilot, Post-launch) with critical path analysis, risk identification with new & unique changes to the hardware, and milestone tracking for the program.
* Drive Program Initiation reviews: scope definition, preliminary annualized failure rate predictions, resource planning, supply chain long-lead identification, and RFP (Request for Proposal) issuance to ODMs

  
Execution & Coordination

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

GE HealthCare’s Bone & Metabolic Health (BMH) business, known worldwide as Lunar, leads the world in dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA). DXA is the clinical reference standard for measuring bone mineral density and body composition. Our measurements are trusted because of their precision, and that precision depends on getting the physics right across the whole system: X-ray source, filtration, beam geometry, detector, mechanics, calibration and analysis.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Systems Engineer who thinks from first principles and enjoys hard technical problems. In this role, you will work out how the system behaves, find out why it sometimes doesn’t, and decide what to change. You will model, measure and explain system performance, lead investigations of complex cross-domain issues, and guide design decisions on new products and the installed base. This is not a requirements-management or traceability role. It is for someone who would rather be in the lab with a phantom and an analysis script than maintaining a requirements database.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and responsibilities**

**System physics and performance**

  

* Own the system-level understanding of how DXA measurements are formed: X-ray spectra, dual-energy attenuation, filtration, scatter, beam hardening, detector response, geometry and dose. Use that understanding to set and defend performance targets.
* Build analytical and numerical models (for example, spectral models, Monte Carlo and error budgets) that predict how subsystem changes affect precision, accuracy, image quality and dose.
* Design and run experiments with phantoms and lab systems to characterize performance, check models against data and quantify margins.
* Identify the parameters that drive measurement accuracy and precision, and turn them into well-reasoned specifications for hardware, firmware, and algorithm teams.

**Technical problem solving**

  

* Lead root-cause investigations of complex system-level issues from development, manufacturing and the field, especially issues that cross mechanical, electrical, detector, software and algorithm boundaries.
* Form hypotheses, design discriminating tests, analyze data rigorously and drive issues to a verified physical explanation and lasting fix.
* Act as the technical escalation point for problems other teams haven’t been able to explain.
* Plan and analyze reliability testing at the system and subsystem level, including accelerated life testing, stress testing and life-data analysis such as Weibull. Use physics-of-failure reasoning to explain degradation mechanisms in X-ray sources, detectors and electro-mechanical components, and to predict field performance.

**Design leadership and integration**

  

* Evaluate design trade-offs (for example, source and filter choices, detector technology, scan geometry, calibration strategy, component substitutions) and recommend options backed by data and physical reasoning.
* Work with detector, algorithm, mechanical, electrical and software engineers to integrate subsystems and make sure the whole system meets its performance targets.
* Assess the system impact of supplier changes, component end-of-life replacements and cost-reduction proposals on the installed base.
* Contribute physics-based input to risk analysis, verification strategy and regulatory submissions. Your role is to supply the technical substance; dedicated owners run those processes.

**Technical influence**

  

* Mentor engineers in physical reasoning, experimental design and data analysis.
* Share findings clearly with engineering, clinical, service, quality and leadership audiences.
* Contribute to the technology roadmap by identifying physics-driven chances to improve precision, lower dose, add clinical capability or reduce cost.

**Required qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in physics, engineering physics, medical physics or a closely related field
* 7+ years of experience in product development, R&D or applied physics, with progressively more technical responsibility
* Strong grounding in X-ray physics and radiation–matter interactions, plus practical experience with X-ray sources, detectors or radiation measurement
* A track record of solving complex, ambiguous technical problems through first-principles analysis, controlled experiments and careful data interpretation
* Strong statistical skills, including measurement uncertainty, precision and accuracy analysis, and design of experiments
* Clear written and spoken communication, including the ability to explain complex physics to non-specialists

**Desired characteristics**

  

* Master’s degree or PhD in physics, medical physics or a related field
* Experience with DXA, CT, radiography or other quantitative X-ray imaging modalities
* Experience with Monte Carlo radiation transport tools (for example, Geant4, MCNP, EGSnrc, PENELOPE)
* Hands-on proficiency with quantitative analysis and modeling tools such as MATLAB or Python (NumPy/SciPy)
* Familiarity with calibration methods, phantom design and quantitative imaging metrology
* Experience working on integrated hardware/software systems in a regulated medical device setting (FDA, IEC 60601, ISO 13485)
* Knowledge of radiation safety and dose optimization
* Curiosity, persistence, and comfort working at the edge of what’s known
* A bias toward the lab: when there’s a question, you’d rather measure it than debate it

**Additional information**

Work location: hybrid with on-site in Madison, WI. Position requires regular presence in engineering labs for system integration and test. Occasional domestic and international travel. Legal authorization to work in the country of employment is required.

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

**Additional Information**
==========================

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineering Manager - CoreAI (Java, Python and Go Engineering Group)
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Do you want to lead engineers who work directly on Java, Python and Go, and associated libraries and tooling to make them faster, more efficient and more reliable for Microsoft, our customers, and millions of developers around the world?

In the Engineering Horizons division within CoreAI, the Java, Python and Go Engineering Group (part of Languages and Frameworks), builds best-in-class support for those languages associated workloads for GitHub, Foundry, Azure and in other Microsoft subsidiaries such as Mojang’s Minecraft and LinkedIn.

A small sample of what we work on: We ship the Microsoft Build of OpenJDK, the Microsoft Build of Go, work on OpenJDK and Go internals with upstream OSS partners, tune Java workloads at massive scale, enable millions of developers with our VS Code Python extensions, skills/plugins, and MCP servers, build insightful performance diagnostic tooling, and act as a liaison between Microsoft and the wider Java, Python and Go ecosystems.

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineering Manager to lead a team of engineers. You’ll grow the team, set its technical direction with partners across Microsoft and the relevant OSS communities, and share our strong desire to make the work of our users and developers more productive, satisfying and enjoyable.

Day to day, you’ll stay close to the technology: reviewing designs and code, mentoring engineers, and working with customers inside and outside Microsoft, partner teams and a wide range of technologies. Our code is written in many languages, with C/C++, Java, Go, Shell, TypeScript, assembly and Python being the most common.

AI-first engineering is part of how CoreAI works. You’ll model the responsible use of AI tools across the development lifecycle, and help the team apply human judgment to, and take ownership of, the requirements, designs and code those tools help produce.

If you are interested in growing your career as an engineering leader, in a team where a healthy work/life balance and your own career path are core principles, there is no better place to do it!

* Lead, coach and grow a team of engineers in a collaborative, inclusive environment where everyone keeps learning and has a clear career path.
* Hire and onboard diverse talent, develop engineers through individual growth plans, and hold a consistent performance and quality bar across the team.
* Drive performance tuning and benchmarking for first-party customer workloads and industry benchmarks, using profiling data, telemetry and customer feedback to decide where to invest.
* Take learnings from first-party customer workloads to bring into products that also serve third-party customers.

* Experiment with AI tools and practices that make the team faster and our software better, measure their impact, and share what works across the organization.
* Work in the open with the OSS language communities and other vendors to upstream improvements and represent Microsoft’s needs in those ecosystems.
* Keep leadership and partner teams informed of plans, progress and risks, and help develop the next generation of engineering leaders.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualififcations**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience managing an engineering team, including hiring and coaching
* 3+ years of experience working in the OpenJDK project
* Experience leading teams that build and ship platforms or runtimes used at very large scale
* 3+ years of experience with language design, compilers, managed runtimes, or OS internals

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including with partner teams and open-source communities

===============

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

The **JPL Communications and Instruments Division** perform scientific investigations, advanced technology research, engineering developments and system implementations encompassing space telecommunications, tracking and active remote sensing using electromagnetic waves.

The **Flight Communications and Tracking Section** provides cost-effective space communications systems, software defined radios, high power RF amplifiers, and power supplies that support primary telecom subsystems and major radar and radiometer science payloads. The section also provides Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) flight equipment, radiometric science instruments, high stability frequency standards and clocks and seismometers for NASA/JPL missions. In addition to flight hardware expertise, the section specializes in collection of and processing of worldwide, fixed site, GNSS data that is processed into clock, atmospheric, and ionospheric GNSS correction metrics. The section also develops high stability frequency references and clocks for flight and ground applications.

The Flight Communications & Tracking Section at JPL is looking for a highly motivated and experienced **Flight Telecom Systems Engineer III** to join their Communication System Engineering and Operations Group. As a member of this Group, you will have an opportunity to be involved in all phases of product development from early concept and mission formulation, low technology readiness specification and prototyping to engineering and flight model development and implementation, functional and environmental testing, and flight operations support. In this role, you will perform complex and wide-ranging engineering tasks across the telecom discipline and its interfaces, exercising increasing independence across the product lifecycle.

**Tasks include but are not limited to:**

* Provide telecom system engineering support on flight telecom subsystems for deep-space, Earth-orbiting, and lunar/Mars relay missions. Generate telecom component and subsystem requirements with flow-down, and verify multifunctional telecom requirements for consistency across interfacing subsystems.
* Conduct system-level link analyses using statistically derived link parameters. Independently evaluate telecom components, algorithms, systems, and end-to-end performance, identifying improvements and risks.
* Apply advanced principles to interpret complex telecom and tracking data and test results. Research subsystem data to inform architecture and risk decisions, partnering with project personnel on risk mitigation plans.
* Lead infusion of new technology into flight telecom products, documenting requirements, progress, and test results. Develop critical technical models for improved multifunctional telecom products.
* Partner with engineers and project personnel on cross-discipline trade studies and analyses of alternatives. Provide telecom support to Team X concurrent design and to mission and concept proposal teams, including formal proposal writing and review.
* Plan, maintain, and document mass, power, and data volume allocations, resolving cross-component conflicts. Perform or independently review reliability analyses (worst-case, parts stress, radiation, thermal, structural) and interface failure mode analysis.
* Draft or update telecom functional description documents, comm behavior manager documents, and design control documents such as ICDs, requirements, test reports, and design description documents.
* Create detailed test plans, procedures, and reports aligned with V&V objectives. Develop critical V&V plans and verify requirements. Support key spacecraft-level ATLO tests: subsystem functional, ground-station compatibility, and environmental testing.
* Collaborate with ground station providers: DSN, NSN, ESTRACK, and commercial providers (e.g., KSAT).
* Support HRCR and CoFR reviews for telecom flight deliveries. Lead disposition of complex, significant-impact ECRs through CCB concurrence and approval, and draft waivers as needed.
* Support the product manager on risks, performance error budgets, trade studies, design integration, and delivery schedules. Present technical status and results at management, project, and design reviews.
* Serve as a real-time telecom operations engineer across all mission phases (launch, cruise, critical events, extended operations), monitoring subsystem health, performance, and link status.
* Support DSN, NSN, and commercial pass planning and execution, including command verification, telemetry acquisition, and link performance against pre-pass predicts. Participate in shift coverage, performing real-time and post-pass assessment and flagging off-nominal performance.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, Embedded Systems Security
new_jobs.description:
At Meta, we're building and operating one of the world's most dynamic and fast-paced networks, powering our global data centers and supporting cutting-edge technologies like AI, Generative AI, Recommendation engines, and the Metaverse. Our network infrastructure teams are responsible for developing, deploying, and operating this complex system, covering the entire network lifecycle from hardware development to operation. FBOSS is a software team in the Network Infrastructure group that powers the network devices Meta runs. FBOSS stands for Facebook Open Switching System - a software stack running on network switches across Meta's global network. We work on some of the most critical infrastructure challenges at Meta, including the networking switch platforms behind our AI clusters for large language models, recommendation systems, and the metaverse. This role is part of our FBOSS Platform SW team which works across every stage of a network switch: defining new switch requirements, hardware/software design, software development, bringing up current Linux kernels on our switch platforms, and supporting them in operation.Why this role, and why now:Our switching platforms have historically operated in facilities where physical access and the surrounding network are tightly controlled. We are now extending these platforms into environments that do not offer those guarantees - including backbone and other less-trusted deployment settings - where the platform itself has to carry security properties it previously inherited from its surroundings. This role exists to close that gap across platform, operating system, and data plane security.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Embedded Systems Security Responsibilities:**

* Own systems design spanning hardware and software, with security treated as a first-class design input rather than a late-stage review
* Operating system security: OS hardening, attestation, image signing and update integrity, credential and key management, privilege and isolation boundaries
* Platform security: secure boot, hardware root of trust, firmware and BMC integrity, signed and verifiable update paths, physical port and console exposure, tamper considerations
* Develop and maintain Linux drivers and board support for custom switch designs, and work with vendors to ensure compliance with our specifications, including security requirements
* Own workstreams focused on hardware bring-up and lead the cross-functional effort to complete engineering validation of new switches
* Work closely with the hardware team to review and influence switch design, ensuring sound software-hardware integration and that security-relevant hardware capabilities are present and usable
* Contribute to BMC software design and structure, including its integrity and trust properties
* Improve platform resilience and operational health, including self-healing and auto-triage approaches for the fleet
* Assess our switching platforms against a threat model that assumes an untrusted physical and network environment, and identify where we are actually exposed
* Work on protecting the data and control planes over links that traverse untrusted environments
* Partner with the kernel team on driver integration and kernel upgrades across switch designs, including timely handling of security fixes
* Partner with security engineering teams to understand applicable requirements, map the stakeholders behind them, and reason through trade-offs - distinguishing must-haves from should-haves and making a defensible case where an exception is warranted

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5+ years of software development experience in networking, distributed systems, or a related technical domain, or PhD with 2+ years of experience in a relevant technical area
* Experience working on systems software in a large-scale C++ code base
* Experience in one or more of: operating systems, Linux, RTOS, containers, or developer-infrastructure tooling
* Knowledge of software development processes such as CI/CD and testing frameworks
* Hands-on experience with operating system or software-supply-chain security - for example OS hardening, image signing, secure update paths, key and credential management, or privilege and isolation boundaries
* Ability to reason about the security implications of running a system in an untrusted environment
* Experience with source control, bug tracking, and design documentation
* Experience developing, debugging, and shipping software on large code bases spanning platforms and tools

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with supply-chain integrity for firmware and software artifacts
* Demonstrated success working collaboratively across large cross-functional teams
* Experience working with security engineering or compliance stakeholders to negotiate requirements and exceptions
* Experience hardening or securing embedded or networking platforms deployed outside a controlled facility

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

new_jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Anyware Robotics is seeking a Robotics Mechatronics Engineer with expertise in electronics to join our team.

### **About Anyware Robotics**

Anyware Robotics builds general-purpose mobile manipulator robots for industrial applications. Our robots are trusted by customers across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, supporting applications such as truck unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending.

### **Description**

Location: Onsite, Fremont

Department: Hardware Team

Employment Type: Full-time

Reports To: Sanchit

**About Anyware**

Anyware Robotics builds general-purpose mobile manipulator robots for industrial applications. Our robots are trusted by customers across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, supporting applications such as truck unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending.

**The Role**

Anyware Robotics is seeking a Robotics Mechatronics Engineer with expertise in electronics to join our team.

As a Mechatronics Engineer, you will work with a team of innovative engineers from various high-tech industries to prototype robotic systems. You will have the opportunity to apply your expertise in electrical, electronics, embedded, and communication sub-systems to design, prototype, test, and deliver features for our advanced generation of robots. You will also work on troubleshooting and integrating sensors, actuators, and control systems to help shape our robotic technology.

**What You’ll Do**

* Collaborate with a team of like-minded innovators to prototype robotic systems.
* Design, assemble, and test custom PCBAs, inclusive of prototyping, integration with the robot, and debugging as per requirements.
* Work on selection and integration of AC–DC converters, DC–DC converters, suitable motors, and motor drives following technical requirements of the robot.
* Design schematics for control architecture involving PLC. Further, implement the same in robots through integration of hardware and development of firmware.
* Work with PLC or microcontrollers for quick proof-of-concept testing.
* Dive into the world of sensors, actuators, and control systems to develop and troubleshoot our robots.
* Investigate and troubleshoot issues in the robot. Develop solutions as well as documentation to reduce potential failures in future.
* Share your knowledge and skills with your teammates, fostering a culture of collaboration, learning, and growth.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Enthusiastic about robotics.
* Currently pursuing or having a degree in fields such as Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent.
* Experience in robotics competition (BattleBot, FRC, etc.), vehicle competition (F-SAE, Baja, etc.), or any technical competition.
* Understanding of digital and analog signals as well as common communication protocols such as UART, I2C, CAN, RS232, etc.
* Solid understanding of electrical circuits, including the ability to read and interpret circuit diagrams, schematics, and wiring drawings.
* Hands-on experience with standard assembly and diagnostic tools, including power tools, hand tools, power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.
* Hands-on experience wiring electromechanical modules in accordance with circuit diagrams and established wiring standards.
* Highly motivated teammate with excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative, and dynamic start-up environment as part of a small team.
* Work on a full-time schedule at our office in Fremont.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience of working with PLCs or microcontrollers.
* Experience of designing PCBAs in either Altium, KiCad, Autodesk Eagle, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with Python or C++.
* Familiarity with robotics software frameworks such as ROS/ROS2.

If you are a motivated and talented engineer looking to gain practical experience in the field of robotics, we would love to hear from you. Join us and contribute to the development of cutting-edge robotic technology with your skills and enthusiasm. This is an exciting opportunity to work on innovative projects and make a real impact on the future of robotics.

**Why Anyware**

* An A+ Team: Anyware is built by a top-tier team. Collectively, our team has won six Best Paper Awards and Finalists, including the ICRA 2025 Best Paper Award and ICRA 2024 Best Paper Award.
* An A+ Robot: Our robot Pixmo has won multiple awards, including a RBR50 and Best Innovation Awards at both ProMat 2025 and MODEX 2026, North America’s largest logistics automation exhibitions. Notably, this is the first time in history that a company has won this prestigious award back-to-back.
* Real Impact: You will contribute directly to deploying the core manipulation intelligence that powers every Pixmo deployment. Your work does not stop at a demo. It ships into real customer sites and solves real problems at scale.
* Fast Growth: You will sharpen your skills with strong ownership and real responsibility. The team size is doubling every year, creating plenty of room for talent to step in and shine.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The expected salary range for this role is from $90,000–$120,000 USD depending on experience and qualifications.

Benefits include daily meals, per diem, PTO, sick leave, and unlimited snacks and beverages in the office.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Anyware is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your resume, portfolio, and any relevant materials through the Anyware Career platform. We look forward to learning more about your experience and interest in joining our team.

#### **Salary**

$90,000 - $120,000 per year

**Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

**Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.**

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

**Firmware Principal Systems Development Engineer**

Join us as a Senior Principal System Development Engineer on our Network HW Engineering team in Santa Clara, CA or Austin, TX to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact.

**What you’ll achieve**
-----------------------

As a **Firmware Principal Systems Development Engineer,** you will be part of the end-to-end development of next-generation Network L10 switches and L11 rack-level solutions for hyperscale, cloud, and AI infrastructure. Working in a fast-paced environment where innovation, technical leadership, and execution excellence are highly valued, you will drive product strategy, architecture, and delivery from concept through production. You will collaborate across hardware, firmware, mechanical, thermal, manufacturing, and supply chain teams to develop scalable, high-performance networking solutions while ensuring alignment with business objectives, customer requirements, and technology roadmaps.

**You will:**

* Lead the FW/Diag end-to-end development of Network L10 switch platforms and L11 rack-level solutions, driving product architecture, qualification, production readiness, and sustaining activities
* Provide technical leadership for system integration across hardware, firmware, software, cabling, optics, power, thermal, and rack infrastructure to deliver scalable, high-performance networking solutions
* Own, develop, and review Diags, ONIE, BMC, BIOS, and platform management specifications, ensuring alignment with product requirements, quality standards, and supportability objectives
* Define and drive validation, test, and integration strategies for system software and hardware components, resolving complex cross-functional issues throughout the product lifecycle
* Partner with engineering teams, ODMs, suppliers, manufacturing, and business stakeholders to manage risks, influence technology roadmaps, accelerate time-to-market, and deliver successful networking products

**Take the first step towards your dream career**
-------------------------------------------------

**Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Essential Requirements**
--------------------------

* 8+ years of experience developing **Diags, ONIE, BMC, BIOS/UEFI,** and platform firmware for networking switch products, including 100G, 400G, 800G, and 1.6T Ethernet platforms
* Strong expertise in embedded software and firmware development, including operating systems, device drivers, platform management, networking protocols, and system-level software architecture
* Deep knowledge of platform security technologies and secure development practices, including PFR, RoT/eROT, Secure Boot, code signing, threat modelling, and SDL methodologies
* Proven ability to architect, develop, debug, and optimize complex, scalable software solutions, while providing technical leadership and mentoring across cross-functional engineering teams
* Expert-level experience with UEFI/EDK II architecture, Broadcom SDKs, PHY drivers, and networking switch platforms, with a strong understanding of system integration, platform bring-up, and deployment within enterprise and hyperscale environments

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
* Ability to lead, motivate and direct a workgroup; capability to influence others to achieve results

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft’s over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for passionate engineers to help achieve that mission.

As Microsoft’s cloud business continues to grow, the ability to deploy new offerings and HW infrastructure on time, in high volume, with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. To achieve this goal, the SCHIE team is instrumental in defining and delivering measures of success for hardware design, qualification, fleet support, scale, and sustainability related to Microsoft cloud hardware.

Azure Memory and Storage Center of Excellence (AMS CoE) is part of the SCHIE organization focusing on memory and storage devices going into the cloud hardware servers. AMS provides memory and storage solutions to Azure and drives memory and storage suppliers to deliver high quality products that meet our requirements. AMS CoE also leads Azure Fault Prediction and Detection (AFPD), the platform that predicts, detects and repairs hardware failures across the Azure fleet.

We are looking for a **Cloud Principal Hardware Engineer** to scale AFPD across hardware components in the Azure fleet and to lead hands-on hardware resiliency for the platform.

The opportunity:

Every hour a server sits unhealthy is an hour of lost customer capacity. AFPD turns hardware, firmware and OS telemetry into early detection and prediction of failures, moves customer workloads off failing nodes, and sends a targeted repair for the part that failed. Repair outcomes and supplier failure analysis then improve the next rule or model.

You will be working on incorporating into the platform components such as storage, memory, power supply, CPU, GPU, NIC, HBA/FPGA, cables and the rest of the server, and you will be the subject matter expert the team relies on when a failure needs to be prevented. Across millions of nodes, each improvement means fewer VM interruptions for customers and faster return of online capacity.

Why this role:

Your impact shows up in fleet availability and customer uptime, quarter over quarter. You will set the hardware direction for a platform that influences production infrastructure at a scale, and you will work directly with Azure engineering, component teams and leading hardware suppliers.

#SCHIE #azurehwjobs

 **Responsibilities**

* Lead failure analysis across server components: characterize failure modes from fleet telemetry and logs and confirm root cause with repair results and supplier failure analysis.

* Define the signals, thresholds, targeted diagnostics and repair recipes, and work with component teams for the root cause analysis.

* Improve isolation accuracy so each repair address the source of failures: improve efficacy of the detection and repair services.

* Partner with software engineers and data scientists on detection rules and prediction models; set precision targets and validation gates before a rule or model takes action on production nodes.

* Use AI agents and machine learning to automate failure analysis, live-site triage and supplier RCA follow-up, and to shorten the time from a new failure signature to a detection rule.

* Lead root cause and corrective actions with server components, including firmware fixes, and feed the learnings back into the platform.

* Lead as the senior hardware escalation point for live-site incidents, from triage through root cause to fleet-wide mitigation.

* Make new server generations and AI/GPU platforms platform-ready before they reach production, with detection, isolation and repair coverage at launch.

* Track and improve metrics & mentor engineers across the team.

 **Qualifications**

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.

  + Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

* Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field AND 7+ years technical engineering experience

* OR Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience

new_jobs.title: Sr. Director, Additive Manufacturing Systems Engineering
new_jobs.description:
**Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future**
======================================

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**Why This Role Exists**
------------------------

Hadrian is building an additive manufacturing capability that runs as part of an autonomous factory, not as a room full of printers. The hard problem is not any single machine, material, or line of code. It is making all of them behave as one system. Systems engineering is the glue that holds that system together, and this role owns the glue.

The Senior Director leads three engineering functions, materials and process engineering, hardware engineering, and software engineering, and is accountable for the digital backbone that binds them to each other and to applications engineering: the architecture, interfaces, and data that connect Hadrian’s Opus platform to cutting-edge additive manufacturing equipment, add automation where it makes sense, fuse sensor data into the part record, and turn a collection of parts into a full, integrated digital manufacturing system built around additive.

The measure of success is not three strong teams. It is one manufacturing system that a customer part flows through, from design intent to qualified hardware, with every decision and every data point captured along the way.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Architect the system.** Define and control the end-to-end architecture for additive at Hadrian: requirements, interfaces, data model, and acceptance criteria that hold across multiple equipment platforms, modalities, and sites. Treat the factory as the product.
* **Build the digital backbone.** Connect additive equipment, peripherals, and inspection assets to Opus with the same discipline a semiconductor fab applies to connecting tools to the host: standardized state models, telemetry, event streams, and data contracts, with security and configuration control built in.
* **Fuse the sensors.** Bring in-situ monitoring, machine telemetry, environmental data, and downstream inspection into one correlated record per part, then move from monitoring to data-driven release and, where it is justified, closed-loop control.
* **Automate where it pays.** Lead automation across additive cells (material and powder handling, build changeover, part removal and depowdering, post-processing flow, robotics, controls, and safety) with a written case for each: safety, repeatability, and data capture first; labor second. Never automate an unstable process.
* **Lead the three functions as one.** Set standards, priorities, and cadence for materials and process, hardware, and software engineering. Resolve conflicts between them at the architecture level, not the escalation level.
* **Own the applications engineering interface.** With the Head of Applications Engineering, define what a production-ready hand-off looks like, publish the process capability and design-rule data applications engineers build to, and close the loop from floor results back into design guidance.
* **Industrialize the equipment.** Through the hardware engineering leader, own factory and site acceptance, commissioning, reliability (preventive maintenance, spares, MTBF/MTTR), and configuration-controlled modification and upgrade of additive systems, and lead the technical relationships with equipment partners that unlock deeper integration. The machine-level depth lives in that team; the standards and the outcomes live here.
* **Design for the factory.** Partner with Factory Development and Factory Automation on cell and site design: material flow, capacity, simulation, utilities, and the path to lights-out operation for additive.
* **Build quality in.** Make the system itself the evidence: traceability, data integrity, and process control that stand up to AS9100 audits and customer qualification without a separate paper trail.
* **Be the additive voice in Hadrian’s platform.** Carry additive requirements into Core Engineering and the Opus roadmap, and bring platform capability back to the floor.
* **Hire, develop, and retain.** Build a leadership bench under you, set a high technical bar, and make Hadrian the place the best additive systems engineers in the country want to work.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a physical science; an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
* 12+ years in advanced manufacturing, with real depth in at least three of these six domains: factory design and industrial automation; semiconductor or other high-reliability capital-equipment engineering; manufacturing software and data systems; materials science and process engineering; quality systems in regulated industries; sensing, process monitoring, and sensor fusion.
* 5+ years leading engineering teams, including leading through managers and building at least one function from the ground up.
* Production experience with metal laser powde
