new_jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a skilled and mechanically inclined **Automation Engineering Technician II** to support custom automated equipment in a precision manufacturing environment.

This position is ideal for a hands-on technician who enjoys troubleshooting complex machinery, working with small and delicate mechanical components, and solving challenging equipment problems independently.

The successful candidate will possess strong mechanical and electromechanical troubleshooting abilities, excellent attention to detail, and the curiosity and patience needed to diagnose unfamiliar equipment issues.

This role involves maintaining, repairing, and improving automated production equipment while collaborating with engineering and manufacturing teams to minimize downtime and maintain consistent production quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Independently troubleshoot, diagnose, repair, and maintain automated manufacturing and assembly equipment.
* Perform preventive maintenance and corrective repairs to maximize equipment uptime and production efficiency.
* Work with small, delicate, and precision-machined components requiring careful handling, assembly, disassembly, and adjustment.
* Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and electromechanical equipment failures.
* Set up, adjust, and maintain precision tooling, automated machinery, robotic equipment, and associated components.
* Investigate unfamiliar equipment problems using logical troubleshooting techniques, technical curiosity, and persistence.
* Support engineering teams with the installation, testing, modification, and implementation of automated manufacturing systems.
* Assist with troubleshooting and maintaining PLC-controlled equipment, robotic systems, sensors, and machine vision systems.
* Support equipment involving precision forming, winding, coiling, or similar mechanical processes.
* Assist with the fabrication, modification, and installation of tooling and fixtures.
* Collaborate with production personnel to prioritize maintenance requests and minimize operational disruptions.
* Monitor and respond to equipment service requests through email and internal communication systems.
* Maintain accurate preventive maintenance records, equipment documentation, and work instructions.
* Identify opportunities to improve machine reliability, efficiency, safety, and overall production performance.
* Communicate professionally with machine operators, engineers, and other internal stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* Associate degree, technical certification, or post-secondary training in electronics, robotics, electromechanical technology, industrial maintenance, or a related technical discipline; **or at least 3 years of relevant hands-on technical experience.**
* Experience troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining manufacturing equipment in an industrial or production environment.
* Strong mechanical aptitude and demonstrated ability to diagnose equipment problems independently.
* Experience working with small precision components, delicate hardware, or equipment requiring detailed assembly and disassembly.
* Knowledge of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and electromechanical systems.
* Ability to interpret equipment problems, investigate root causes, and implement effective repairs with minimal supervision.
* Strong attention to detail, patience, and a methodical approach to troubleshooting.
* Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with production personnel and engineering teams.
* Comfortable working directly on the manufacturing floor in a hands-on technical capacity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in high-volume, precision, or automated manufacturing environments.
* Background in automotive manufacturing, industrial automation, precision assembly, or similar technical industries.
* Experience with precision coiling equipment, coiler heads, winding machinery, or related mechanical systems.
* Familiarity with laser cutting, laser welding, or laser-based manufacturing equipment.

**ELECTRICAL ENGINEER (INDUSTRIAL AUTOMATION)**

Freeform builds AI-native manufacturing systems that unify software, hardware, and physics to produce industrial-scale parts at the speed of human ideation. By treating manufacturing as a single integrated system, we unlock a new era of innovation where complex hardware is designed, built, and scaled without limits.

As an Electrical Automation Engineer at Freeform, you will contribute significantly to electrical system design, development, and integration efforts for our advanced metal 3D printing factories, with a specific focus on automation design. Your ownership will include but is not limited to automation system architecture, sensor and actuator selection, electrical schematic capture, cabinet layout and build, and wire and cable harness design. You will use a first principles approach to solving problems and tackling new areas within electrical engineering that you may not have directly worked on before. The ideal candidate is capable of running projects from cradle to grave and can work effectively with other engineering disciplines.

You'll be building the electrical backbone of machines that combine high-power lasers, high-speed galvanometer scanning, precision motion, and inert-gas processing of reactive metal powders, all instrumented with high-speed sensing and data acquisition that feeds our real-time controls. While you won't own every one of these subsystems, you will work side by side with the different engineers who do, and you'll get hands-on exposure to FPGA-based hardware, optomechanical assemblies, and complex electromechanical systems that most automation roles never touch.

new_jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you'll do more than join something — you'll add something. The Vision Products Group (VPG) creates the technologies behind Apple Vision Pro and the spatial experiences that reach across Apple's platforms. Our team builds spatial media experiences such as Spatial Scenes, which turn a photo into an immersive 3D scene you can look around in. We work where machine learning meets computer graphics: we train models that generate 3D scenes from photos and videos, and we render them in real time on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro. We are looking for an engineer with a strong machine learning background and a love of graphics who wants to take new ideas from prototype all the way to features used by millions of people.

We are a team of computer graphics, multimedia, and machine learning experts, and we are looking for an engineer to help build the next generation of spatial media across Apple's platforms. You will design and train models that reconstruct and generate 3D scenes from photos and videos, and develop the rendering techniques that bring these scenes to life on Apple devices within the tight compute and memory budgets. You will work closely with software, hardware, algorithms, and UX teams to take your work from early prototypes to shipping features.

* Familiarity with C++, Objective-C, or Swift

Skyline Products designs and manufactures LED dynamic message signs and electronic price signs from our facility in Colorado Springs. For more than 55 years, our signs have been installed on highways, toll roads, and fueling stations across the United States, delivering information that drivers rely on every day. We are a focused engineering and manufacturing team where your work goes directly into products in the field.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Systems Engineer with an electrical engineering foundation to join our engineering team developing LED message signs and control systems for the transportation industry. These signs are installed over highways and play a critical role in public safety and traffic management.  
This role sits squarely at the intersection of hardware and software. You’ll develop firmware for bare-metal microcontrollers and embedded Linux controllers, contribute to circuit and PCB design, and serve as a go-to engineer for problems that don’t stay neatly on one side of the hardware/software line, from a dead pixel on the bench to an intermittent communication fault on a sign mounted to an overpass. The ideal candidate is a methodical troubleshooter who is equally comfortable with a scope probe, a schematic, and a debugger, and who doesn’t consider a problem closed until the root cause is proven.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead root-cause investigations of field, production, and lab failures that span firmware, circuitry, components, PCB assembly, cabling/connectors, and environmental stress (heat, vibration, moisture), and drive them to verified corrective action

* Participate in electronic hardware design: schematic review, PCB layout review, component selection, and board bring-up
* Develop and tune RGB LED color mixing: per-color current and PWM balancing, white-point and color-matching across LED bins, and brightness/color consistency over temperature and dimming levels

* Design and build test fixtures, automated test rigs, and lab tools (Python plus instrumentation) to reproduce intermittent failures and validate fixes
* Debug hardware/software issues using oscilloscopes, logic and protocol analyzers, JTAG/SWD debuggers, and other bench instruments
* Support production, contract manufacturers, and field service with failure analysis, pre-installation sign inspections, and on-site troubleshooting when needed
* Design systems with long-term reliability, diagnostics, and field maintainability in mind
* Ensure compliance with transportation and industry standards (e.g., NTCIP, NEMA TS 4) for robustness and safety
* Write and maintain technical documentation, including design documents, test procedures, failure analysis reports, and controlled quality documents

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (preferred) or Computer Engineering; Master’s a plus
* 5+ years of combined embedded hardware and firmware development experience
* Demonstrated, systematic troubleshooting ability across the hardware/software boundary: able to isolate whether a fault lives in firmware, circuit design, a component, assembly, or interconnect, and back the conclusion with data
* Ability to read and interpret schematics, datasheets, and PCB layouts; solid grasp of analog and digital circuit fundamentals
* Hands-on proficiency with lab instruments: oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, DMMs, power supplies, and in-circuit debuggers
* Proficiency in C in resource-constrained embedded environments (C++ a plus)
* Experience with bare-metal microcontroller development and bring-up (e.g., ARM Cortex-M, PIC, STM32)

* Clear written communication: able to write failure analysis findings for management, customers, and suppliers

**Preferred Qualifications**

new_jobs.description:
**Be one of the Bedo 100**
--------------------------

Albedo is making Very Low Earth Orbit (VLEO) mainstream, building the infrastructure to enable every satellite mission to enter this new orbital domain. We build buses, integrated satellites, and turnkey missions for customers to thrive in VLEO, below 300 km, where proximity compounds performance and drag self-cleans debris.

As part of the first 100 employees at Albedo, you will have a big impact on Albedo's trajectory to proliferating VLEO — whether you're advancing hardware to increase satellite longevity, scaling production for large constellations, building next-gen flight and ground software to push performance, or enabling missions that matter for national security and our day-to-day life here on Earth.

**How We Operate:** Albedo takes a first-principles approach — in space and in business. We move with speed, take calculated risks, and learn quickly. We use AI regularly to create leverage in every discipline across the company. We work in-person at our Broomfield, CO HQ to maximize team and company productivity. We work hard and with urgency to compound our first-mover advantage.

**Who We're Looking For:** Builders who want to own outcomes, not tasks. Systems thinkers who balance precision with iteration while thinking about the big picture. Individuals who are energized by creating a category rather than competing in an existing one. You'll join a team that has already proven what others said wasn't feasible and is now scaling and upgrading our VLEO buses & payloads to serve mission sets across sensing, communications, and responsive operations.

If you can feel the excitement running through your veins, apply to be one of the Bedo 100.

### **What You'll Do**

* Develop and integrate flight applications in C and C++ for telemetry management, GNC algorithm scheduling, and payload software management, each running as its own process on a publish/subscribe message bus.
* Write software for our imaging payload computer: the code that runs the imaging sensor and moves mission data from the sensor toward the ground.
* Work directly with our avionics hardware and our Yocto-built embedded Linux, including kernel and device drivers, alongside the engineers who built it.
* Benchmark our software to make sure we meet tight timing constraints, and close the gap when we don't (threading, user space vs. kernel space, offloading to hardware).
* Verify our software works end-to-end, from ground communication to spacecraft commanding, and take part in integration and test campaigns.
* Write and run automated tests using Python at every level, from software-in-the-loop to hardware-in-the-loop, and help maintain the automated CI/CD systems behind them, both software-only and with real hardware.

### **Your Ideal Skills and Experience:**

* Strong C and C++ on embedded Linux, including multithreaded applications and how timing and threading actually behave on Linux.
* Have set up or worked in a cross-compiled environment: CMake, GDB, and a build system like Yocto, Buildroot, or PetaLinux.
* Understand trade-offs when it comes to topics such as memory, processor capacity, hardware offloading, latency/bandwidth, or build versus re-use.
* Can use version control such as Git, are comfortable with merge-request code review, and you might be pedantic about how you version your software (like using SemVer).
* Demonstrate a core competency in one, or many, of the following: networking communication, distributed computing, publish/subscribe middleware (like DDS), Linux driver development, state machine modeling, real-time operating systems, software/hardware simulations, or pick your flavor of nerding out and tell us!
* Most importantly, want to learn, and want to be challenged.

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on Yocto experience (it's how we build our flight Linux).
* Software that has flown, or was built to fly: satellites, launch vehicles, aircraft, or drones.
* Software for embedded imaging sensors or camera pipelines (sensor drivers, V4L2, MIPI CSI).
* Rust.
* Lua, Python or another embedded scripting language.
* Spacecraft command and telemetry experience (CCSDS protocols, command/telemetry databases).
* Startup experience: comfortable with broad scope, moving fast, and learning along the way.

$116,000 - $135,000 a year

  + 4% direct matching 401k
  + Health Insurance: 100% employee coverage & 75% dependent coverage

The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, Production, Purchasing, Service, and external partners to develop solutions that enhance vessel functionality, reliability, manufacturability, and owner experience.

From concept development through prototype validation and production launch, this engineer will help shape the electrical architecture of future Bertram yachts while supporting continuous improvement initiatives across existing models.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys both hands-on problem solving and technical design work, and who is motivated by seeing innovative ideas become world-class products on the water.

**Key Responsibilities**

Electrical System Design & Development

* Design and develop complete AC and DC electrical systems for vessels ranging from 30 to 70 feet.
* Develop electrical architectures, schematics, wiring diagrams, harness layouts, and system integration plans.
* Create innovative electrical solutions that improve vessel performance, functionality, reliability, and serviceability.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external engineering partners to develop and implement new products and technology.

Product Development & Integration

* Support new product development initiatives from concept through production launch.
* Participate in design reviews and cross-functional engineering activities to ensure system compatibility and integration.
* Work closely with prototype builds and validation efforts to verify design intent and performance requirements.
* Develop production-ready solutions that balance performance, quality, cost, and manufacturability.

CAD Modeling & Technical Documentation

* Develop and maintain electrical CAD models, schematics, production drawings, installation documentation, and technical specifications.
* Create and maintain accurate Bills of Materials (BOMs) and engineering release documentation.
* Develop vendor drawings and technical packages for externally manufactured components and assemblies.
* Maintain engineering documentation and revision control throughout the product lifecycle.

Manufacturing & Production Support

* Provide technical guidance and engineering support to production teams during vessel construction.
* Troubleshoot electrical and system integration issues during prototype and production builds.
* Create redline drawings and engineering changes to support continuous product improvement.
* Develop installation standards, best practices, and build documentation that improve quality and consistency across manufacturing operations.
* Participate in production ramp-up activities to ensure successful implementation of new products.

Supplier & Vendor Collaboration

* Work with suppliers and external partners to develop custom electrical components and assemblies, including AC/DC panels, harnesses, and related electrical systems.
* Evaluate vendor solutions and ensure compliance with performance, quality, and regulatory requirements.
* Support sourcing initiatives by providing technical expertise during supplier selection and component evaluation.

Standards, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

* Ensure all designs comply with applicable ABYC, USCG, and other marine industry standards.
* Support the development and maintenance of engineering standards, electrical design guidelines, and best practices.
* Provide technical training and knowledge transfer to production personnel and other stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to improve product quality, system reliability, engineering efficiency, and manufacturing effectiveness.
* Support service, warranty, and field issue investigations to drive continuous product improvement.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.
* Minimum three years of experience designing electrical systems within a manufacturing environment.
* Experience developing, integrating, and implementing new electrical system designs.
* Proficiency with 2D and 3D CAD software.
* Strong understanding of electrical schematics, wiring systems, component selection, and system integration principles.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing and new product development processes.
* Ability to develop technical documentation and provide effective written and verbal instruction.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Marine industry experience with recreational, commercial, or military vessels.
* Extensive knowledge of ABYC standards, USCG regulations, and marine electrical best practices.
* Experience with vessel control systems, battery management systems, digital switching platforms, or marine electronics integration.
* Experience supporting products from concept development through production launch.
* Familiarity with engineering change management, ERP systems, and prod

new_jobs.title: Lead Electrical Engineer - Saminco Technologies
new_jobs.description:
**Lead Electrical Engineer**

Saminco Technologies is a company that designs, manufactures, and supports advanced electric propulsion, power electronics, motor control, and industrial power technologies for mining, rail, transportation, heavy-duty hybrid/electric vehicles, and industrial equipment applications.

We are seeking an experienced Lead Electrical Engineer to lead our electrical engineering team while remaining hands-on in the design and development of electric traction drives, propulsion systems, power-conversion products, and accessories. This is a player-coach role. The successful candidate will bring proven people-leadership experience, including mentoring engineers, guiding priorities, holding regular one-on-one meetings, and conducting performance reviews, together with the technical depth to develop control algorithms, lead electrical design, and solve difficult problems in high-power systems. The Lead Electrical Engineer will work closely with the software, mechanical, manufacturing, test, service, and customer teams to move projects from concept through commissioning and field operation. This is a key role in our growth: you will not only build and develop the electrical engineering team, but also help shape the products, processes, and future direction of the company. This position works in a team environment at our office in Fort Myers, FL. This is not a remote position.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

People Leadership

* Lead, manage, and develop a team of electrical engineers, holding regular one-on-one meetings with each direct report to review progress, remove obstacles, and provide guidance.
* Mentor engineers on technical skills, engineering judgment, and professional development, and actively support each engineer's career growth.
* Teach and share expertise in motor control, power electronics, and electrical design best practices through design reviews, hands-on coaching, and informal training.
* Help engineers set and balance priorities across multiple projects, aligning their work with project schedules, customer commitments, and business needs.
* Conduct performance reviews, set clear goals and expectations, and provide honest, timely feedback throughout the year.
* Participate in hiring, onboarding, and resource planning for the electrical engineering team.
* Build a team culture of ownership, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement.

Engineering Design and Project Delivery

* Develop control algorithms and control strategies for electric propulsion and traction-drive systems, and work with the software team as they implement, test, and validate them.
* Lead the electrical design, development, and performance testing of new propulsion systems, power-conversion products, and accessories.
* Develop performance specifications and performance calculations for propulsion systems.
* Review schematics and designs produced by the team, and make or guide key technical decisions.
* Look for opportunities to reduce design complexity, increase part reuse and commonality across product lines, and lower product and manufacturing costs.
* Help develop and continuously improve standardized engineering processes, including design reviews, documentation, testing, and design release.
* Keep engineering work, documentation, and project records well organized, and set clear expectations for organization across the team.
* Coordinate and lead the resolution of field problems related to the reliability and performance of propulsion systems.
* Define and document project scopes of work and system Bills of Materials.
* Monitor projects through design, manufacture, commissioning, and operation.
* Participate in peer reviews at project milestones.
* Interface directly with customers on technical requirements, project status, and field issues.
* Follow applicable safety, quality, and confidentiality requirements.
* Use AI tools to speed up routine engineering work such as checking calculations and documenting designs, using sound judgment about when to trust the output, and encourage the team to find, test, and share new ways to work more efficiently.

**Qualifications & Competencies**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.
* Five or more years of electrical engineering experience in power electronics, motor drives, power conversion, or a related field.
* Two or more years of experience directly supervising engineers, including conducting performance reviews, holding regular one-on-one meetings, and setting goals and priorities for the team.
* Demonstrated success mentoring, teaching, and developing engineers.
* Thorough understanding of AC and DC motor control theory.
* Thorough understanding of power-electronics topologies and architectures.
* Experience working closely with software teams to define control requirements and to test and validate power-electronics functions.
* Experience with power-conversion products.
* Comfortable working with high-power designs, up to 3300 V and 1200 A IGBTs.
* Proven ability to read and interpret module specifications and schematics.
* Demonstrated success simplifying designs, increasing part reuse, reducing costs, and developing or improving standardized engineering processes.
* Excellent problem-solving skills.
* Highly organized, with strong attention to detail.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and directly with customers.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities with minimal direct supervision.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* Experience with electric propulsion or traction-drive systems for rail, transit, mining, marine, electric-vehicle, or industrial applications.
* Experience building or growing an engineering team.
* Familiarity with IEC and UL practices and ISO 9001 quality systems.
* Experience in a low-volume, high-mix manufacturing environment, including new-prod

new_jobs.title: SITEC - Riverbed Systems Engineer - MacDill AFB
new_jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **Program Overview**

Peraton provides USSOCOM, its Component Commands, Theater Special Operations Commands (TSOCs), deployed forces, CIO/J6, and end-users with high-quality IT platform and network services over an eight-year period.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton requires Systems Engineers to support the Special Operation Command Information Technology Enterprise Contract (SITEC) – 3 EOM. This position is located at MacDill AFB in Florida.

The purpose of the Special Operations Forces Information Technology Enterprise Contract (SITEC) 3 Enterprise Operations and Maintenance (EOM) Task Order (TO) is to provide USSOCOM, its Component Commands, its Theater Special Operations Commands (TSOCs), and its deployed forces with Operations and Maintenance (O&M) services to maintain Network Operations (NetOps); maintain systems and network infrastructure; provide end user and common device support; provide configuration, change, license, and asset management; conduct training, and perform Install, Move, Add, Change (IMACs) services. The responsibilities and tasks associated with each requirement play a pivotal role to USSOCOM, the CIO/J6 organization, and ultimately the end-user who operate around the globe 24x7x365.

The Riverbed Systems Engineer serves as the senior technical authority for Riverbed performance monitoring, digital experience management, and network visibility platforms across the enterprise environment. This role is responsible for engineering, administration, optimization, cybersecurity compliance, and lifecycle management of Riverbed technologies excluding SteelHead WAN optimization appliances.

  

The engineer will operate within and support multiple classified and unclassified environments, ensuring secure, compliant, and highly available performance monitoring capabilities across J6 mission systems.

  

This position supports operations within the following enclaves:

  

* NIPR (Non-classified Internet Protocol Router Network)
* SIPR (Secret Internet Protocol Router Network)
* SOCRATES (as defined by the supported command architecture)

The Riverbed SME will manage and support the following suites, as deployed:

  

* Riverbed AppResponse
* Riverbed NetProfiler
* Riverbed Portal
* Riverbed Aternity
* Riverbed NPM+

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Architecture & Engineering

* Design and implement secure Riverbed monitoring architectures across NIPR, SIPR, and SOCRATES enclaves.
* Develop enclave-specific system design documentation and data flow diagrams.
* Engineer scalable deployments supporting hybrid, virtual, and physical infrastructures.
* Integrate Riverbed tools with SIEM, ITSM, cybersecurity, and enterprise monitoring platforms.
* Ensure cross-domain and enclave segmentation compliance.

* Operations & Administration

* Provide Tier II/III engineering support and root cause analysis.
* Administer platform configuration, system health monitoring, and performance tuning.
* Perform software upgrades, patching, backups, and disaster recovery validation.
* Maintain role-based access controls (RBAC) and auditing policies.
* Support configuration management and change control boards (CCB).
* Proficiency in Windows and Linux operating systems.
* Combine subsystems, resolve compatibility issues, and ensure interoperability

* Performance Monitoring & Optimization

* Analyze application, network, and endpoint performance trends.
* Generate executive dashboards and mission-impact assessments.
* Develop actionable insights to reduce latency, packet loss, and user-impacting incidents.
* Tune alert thresholds and monitoring policies to reduce noise.

* Cybersecurity & Compliance

* Maintain compliance with DoD cybersecurity standards and STIG requirements.
* Support ATO lifecycle documentation and security control validation.
* Coordinate vulnerability scanning, remediation, and patch cycles.
* Ensure enclave-specific hardening baselines are maintained.

* Documentation & Reporting

* Develop and maintain SOPs, engineering diagrams, and operational runbooks.
* Provide weekly/monthly operational reports to leadership.
* Brief senior leadership on system health, trends, and risk posture.

* Collaboration & Leadership

* Coordinate with Network, Cybersecurity, Systems, and Application teams.
* Support incident response and war-room troubleshooting efforts.
* Provide mentorship to junior administrators and engineers.
* Serve as the technical liaison between contractor teams and government leadership.

* Troubleshooting and Support

* Monitor the health and performance of the monitoring servers themselves, proactively addressing any issues.
* Investigate and resolve issues related to data collection, ensuring all monitored devices are reporting correctly.

* Basic to intermediate scripting skills (PowerShell, Bash, Python) for automation of routine tasks.

##### **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Min 12 years with HS degree, 10 years with AS/AA degree, 8 years with BS/BA, 6 years with MS/MA, 3 years with PhD
* DoW 8570 IAT II Certification
* DoW TS/SCI clearance
* Must be DoW 8140 compliant under the Work Role Code 451 – System Administrator - Inte

new_jobs.title: Antenna Systems Electrical Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About us:

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.

What you'll do:

We're looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the design, integration, and sustaining engineering of antenna systems spanning all frequency bands! This role works under the direction of senior/technical lead engineers. In this role you will contribute independently on core design, documentation, BOM development, and test support tasks. Solid RF fundamentals and a strong electrical design/documentation toolset are what matter most!

The day-to-day:

**Electrical Design & Documentation**

* Develop and maintain schematics, wiring diagrams, and harness/interconnect documentation using EPLAN, DraftSight, and/or Visio.
* Apply Develop for Excellence (DFX) principles, including DFM and DFT or equivalent experience
* Apply established design standards, review checklists, and documentation practices to new and sustaining designs.
* Participate in design reviews and support resolution of design issues identified during review or test.

**Systems & Project Engineer Fundamentals**

* Apply working knowledge of RF/antenna fundamentals (EIRP, G/T, sidelobes, linearity, noise figure, gain, VSWR) to support design architecture and drive program commonality.
* Identify and support requirement flow-downs from system to subsystem/LRU level and help maintain traceability records.
* Help select appropriate test approaches and equipment for characterizing RF performance.
* Support cost/schedule estimate development for proposals and sustaining engineering tasks.

**Multi-functional Collaboration**

* Work with manufacturing and supply chain to support BOM structure, part data integrity, quality control, and configuration control.
* Identify and mitigate risks and opportunities alongside program leadership.
* Actively participate in vGate meetings to ensure program success and handoff to other engineering teams as required, e.g. Test Engineering.
* Attend and actively participate in customer meetings as a part of program leadership, when required.
* Identify quality concerns and advance appropriately to ensure suppliers and internal groups are held in compliance.
* Assist in evaluating and adopting engineering automation and toolchain improvements (e.g., EPLAN workflows, traceability tools, QA checks) introduced by technical leads.

What you'll need:

* 4+ years of relevant experience in electrical engineering, RF/antenna systems, or related product design.
* Working knowledge of RF and satellite communications principles and how they translate to product requirements.
* Hands-on proficiency with Siemens NX, EPLAN, DraftSight, and/or Visio (please indicate which tools you've used and at what depth).
* Familiarity with RF hardware and integration elements: SSPA, TWTA, TLT, LNA, LNB, ACU, waveguide, cabling, filters, power dividers, terminations, etc.
* Exposure to antenna test S parameters, and test equipment (VNA, signal generators, Spectrum analyzers).
* Basic understanding of regulatory/compliance frameworks (UL, NEC, IEC, FCC, ETSI, ITU) is a plus, not required.
* Strong documentation habits, attention to detail, and clear technical communication.
* Comfortable working across hardware/test/manufacturing boundaries to solve issues.
* BS in Electrical Engineering, Antenna Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Ability to support up to ~10–15% travel.
* Must be able to work out of the Duluth, GA office.
* US Citizenship required.
* Must be able to obtain a United States Secret Clearance

  
What will help you on the job:

* Prior exposure to phased array or multi-band antenna systems.
* Experience supporting design-for-manufacture reviews or supplier technical evaluations.
* Interest in engineering automation/toolchain modernization (schematic linting, traceability tools, BOM normalization).

new_jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Jose, CA, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Austin, TX, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience building developer tools (e.g., compilers, automated releases, code design and testing, test automation frameworks).
* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* Experience in software engineering productivity (e.g., test automation, refactoring code, test-driven development, build infrastructure, optimizing software, debugging, building tools and testing frameworks).
* Experience building software infrastructure for projects such as repositories and release workflows.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in engineering productivity or site reliability engineering roles.
* Experience with hardware and laboratory bring-up processes.
* Experience in test automation, refactoring code, test-driven development, build infrastructure, optimizing software, and debugging.
* Experience with the Fuchsia operating system ecosystem or other operating systems.
* Ability to communicate and work with others on technical projects.
* Ability to prioritize requests from partner teams and triage technical issues.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

  
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Deliver infrastructure to testing components and products based on knowledge of differences and considerations for each test phase (e.g., validity, verification, performance, reliability, usability, stress testing) and develop tests to test out infrastructure for each of the major phases of software development.
* Build a suite of monitoring and anomaly detection tools which help us reduce our overall flakiness.
* Improve the tooling used to identify latency during builds and find ways to improve stability.
* Work closely with EngProd, TPM, Engineering, and Product Management teams to help deliver our infrastructure as a whole.
* Generate the ideas required to solve technical problems and take full ownership of delivering the solution.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. new_jobs.title: STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER
new_jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Develop, deploy, operate, and maintain infrastructure platform software for Site Reliability Engineering, with a focus on ensuring the observability, availability, and operational efficiency of enterprise retail store systems.
* Build and extend internal reliability platforms deployed on Google Cloud Platform and Google Kubernetes Engine, using infrastructure-as-code tools including Terraform and cdk8s (Cloud Development Kit for Kubernetes written in TypeScript) to provision and manage cloud resources and Kubernetes workloads programmatically.
* Deploy, configure, tune, and maintain open-source observability systems including Grafana, Loki (log aggregation), Tempo (distributed tracing), Prometheus (metrics collection), Pyroscope (continuous profiling), and AlertManager (alert routing) on Google Kubernetes Engine clusters.
* Write queries in PromQL, LogQL, and TraceQL to build dashboards, configure alert rules, and troubleshoot production infrastructure issues.
* Define and implement Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and error budgets using Prometheus-based SLI queries and multi-window, multi-burn-rate alerting configurations for monitoring across multiple application services.
* Develop and maintain operational automation platform infrastructure, including provisioning and managing automation runners on both Kubernetes (via cdk8s) and virtual machines (via Terraform), developing integration plugins, managing access control lists through GitHub-backed configuration, and resolving platform support requests.
* Build automation to reduce operational toil, including self-service onboarding tools, GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployments, and AI-assisted workflows using GitHub Copilot.
* Participate in on-call rotation for observability and automation infrastructure.
* Investigate and resolve production incidents affecting logging, tracing, profiling, and automation platforms.
* Contribute to blameless post-mortem reviews and implement systemic improvements.
* Validate platform resilience through destructive and performance testing.
* Document platform operations, create runbooks, and maintain onboarding guides for internal engineering teams.
* Telecommuting available.

  
**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* Must be eighteen years of age or older.
* Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology Management, Electronics Engineering, or a related field and 3 years of experience in a related occupation.

Role Overview

  

The Software Engineer (.NET/Azure) is a hands-on, mid-level contributor responsible for designing, building, and modernizing high-volume, high-transaction applications across the Experian Employer Services (EES) organization. You will write production code, participate in code reviews, evaluate SAST findings, and work closely with product, quality engineering, security, and operations partners to deliver secure, reliable software to our clients and partners.

AI and automation are the main focus of our team. EES is adopting an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI DLC) and spec-driven agentic development, in which teams define intent, constraints, acceptance criteria, and validation before AI agents build approved work. As an engineer in this model you will work from versioned specifications, direct AI coding agents to implement approved work, and oversee the review, testing, and security validation of what they produce. You will have already worked this way hands-on; this is a requirement of the role, not a learning goal. Humans remain accountable for technical decisions, data protection, and production outcomes.

At Experian, we believe great work happens when people come together. We're focused on attracting talent in and around our designated hub locations who are open to collaborating with colleagues in person. Aligning employees to these talent markets helps foster collaboration, strengthen team connections, and support long-term career growth within Experian. This hybrid role reports to the Engineering Manager, Application Engineering, and reside in or near one of our collaboration hubs:

Costa Mesa, CA; San Jose, CA; Allen, TX; Austin, TX; Franklin, TN; New York, NY; Schaumberg, IL; Washington, D.C.; Atlanta, GA; Boston, MA; Seattle, WA

Responsibilities:

* Analyze new feature requirements with attention to design, software development best practices, testing strategy, database design, security, and cloud architecture, and turn them into clear, versioned specifications with explicit acceptance criteria that engineers and AI agents can verify.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents (for example GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to implement approved work, and own the review, testing, and security validation of AI-generated code before it is merged. Decide when a change needs additional human review based on its risk.
* Build new and modernize existing .NET applications, APIs, and partner integrations, including responsive, accessible web UIs that work across devices.
* Write high-quality, well-tested code: unit tests, integration tests, and contract tests, with observability built in.
* Automate repetitive engineering and operational work (pipelines, environment setup, test data, deployments) rather than performing it by hand.
* Maintain the team's reusable agent instructions, skills, and coding standards for the codebase, and help teammates use agentic tools well.
* Participate in code reviews and provide meaningful feedback on human-written and AI-generated code alike.
* Follow Experian's Secure SDLC. Evaluate and resolve SAST findings, handle sensitive and personal data safely, and never expose such data to AI tools or non-production environments without approved controls.
* Resolve defects identified by quality engineering and demonstrate completed functionality to the Product team for approval.
* Promote a DevOps culture, work with IT and operations, and participate in the on-call rotation for platform emergencies.
* Work within Agile and Scrum delivery while adapting planning and reporting as specifications and system-generated evidence replace ceremony-driven tracking.

  
  

Experience and Skills

  

* Hands-on experience with spec-driven agentic development (mandatory). At least one year of personally using AI coding assistants or agents on production code: working from specifications, constraining the agent's scope, testing and reviewing its output, and deciding what requires human approval.
* Experience working within an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI DLC) or a comparable spec-driven model with explicit specifications, automated validation, and human oversight.
* 6+ years of professional .NET development experience with C#, .NET 8+ (and .NET Framework for maintenance of existing systems), and ASP.NET Core.
* 2+ years building and operating solutions on Azure, including services such as App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Azure Monitor.
* Experience with MS SQL Server, T-SQL, relational database design, and Entity Framework Core or a comparable ORM.
* Experience designing, building, and integrating REST APIs and partner integrations, including authentication, versioning, and error handling.
* Solid front-end experience with HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and one modern SPA framework (Angular or React).
* Experience with service oriented or microservice architecture, messaging, and common cloud-native patterns.
* Experience with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, Git branching workflows, and automated testing in the pipeline.
* Working knowledge of secure coding practices, SAST remediation, and handling of sensitive and personal data.
* Experience with Agile and Scrum delivery.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience building GenAI-enabled features with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, or similar, including retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, and output evaluation.
* Familiarity with Agent Skills or similar standards for reusable agent instructions and workflows.
* Experience with Playwright or similar end-to-end testing frameworks.
* Experience modernizing legacy .NET Framework applications and integrating acquired technologies into an existing product ecosystem.

At Arrive AI (Nasdaq: ARAI), we're not just building products; we're transforming the future of the Autonomous Last Mile™ (ALM). Over a decade ago, we started with a pioneering vision and patents for the first smart mailbox for drone delivery. Through systematic research, development, and deep customer collaboration, we've evolved to today, where we deploy Arrive Points: smart lockers and mini-cross-docks for frictionless drone, robotic, and courier delivery, from medical supplies to meals to e-commerce. Arrive AI is now scaling the ALM network and platform of the future for all autonomous delivery providers, services, and customers. We are the intelligent choice for the last inch of the Autonomous Last Mile™.

**About Us**

We move fast, balancing strategy with opportunity. We are merit-based, valuing integrity, innovation, and treating others as we want to be treated. At Arrive AI, every employee is an equity holder and a business owner. Our shared vision, ownership, and culture fuel our mission to revolutionize autonomous delivery.

**Product Team**

You'll be joining Arrive AI's Product Team to revolutionize Autonomous Last Mile (ALM) logistics by transforming over a decade of research, design, and customer collaboration into the world's first autonomous logistics network and platform. Our fast-paced skunkworks team rapidly iterates, prototypes, and develops next-generation Arrive Point units, networks, and AI-powered platforms. By integrating hardware, robotics, IoT, software, data, AI, and manufacturing, we're driving a bold roadmap for ALM innovation. Based in Fishers, IN, we offer a unique opportunity to do your life's best work, shape the future, and share in the success.

**The Role**

We're seeking a Senior Robotics Engineer to own our autonomous mobile robot (AMR) workflow end-to-end. You will be responsible for simulation, navigation, localization, docking, and deployment on physical robots. You'll work on AMRs driving to an Arrive Point and aligning with it, docking, and completing package handoff, and you'll manage that work both in simulation and on the device.

This is a hands-on senior role. You'll be the technical owner of the robotics stack, working directly in ROS 2, Nav2, NVIDIA's Isaac Sim, and on the robots themselves. You will own the sensory-motor stack, knowing how to integrate, calibrate, and tune each of its components.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the AMR stack: Maintain and extend our ROS 2 stack on NVIDIA Jetson Orin-based robots, from hardware interfaces and ros2\_control through navigation, docking, and mission orchestration.
* Navigate and localize: Build, tune, and validate Nav2 configurations (planners, controllers, costmaps, collision monitoring), SLAM map building, and localization (AMCL, EKF-based sensor fusion) for real delivery environments.
* Plan and control motion: Develop path planning and motion control for holonomic and swerve-drive platforms, including kinematics, motion profiling, and odometry.
* Align and dock with fiducials: Develop precision alignment and docking to Arrive Points using AprilTag fiducials fused with LiDAR, including camera intrinsic and extrinsic calibration, TF frame management, and recovery behaviors.
* Integrate and calibrate sensors: Bring up, calibrate, and fuse 2D and 3D LiDAR, RGB and RGB-D cameras, IMUs, and GNSS on the robot.

* Education and experience: A master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or a related field with 3 to 5 years of industry experience, or a PhD with 3 or more years of industry experience. We weigh hands-on work with real robots heavily.
* End-to-end ownership: A track record of owning a robotics stack from simulation to physical deployment, not just one module within it.
* Linux: Expert use of Linux (Ubuntu), including WSL2, Docker, and SSH-based work on embedded targets.
* ROS 2: Deep experience with ROS 2 (Humble and/or Jazzy), including ros2\_control, TF2, launch systems, and DDS configuration.
* Nav2: Hands-on experience configuring and tuning Nav2 on a real robot, including planners, controllers (for example Regulated Pure Pursuit or MPPI), costmaps, behavior trees, and docking.
* SLAM, localization, and LiDAR: SLAM (for example slam\_toolbox), AMCL, and EKF-based sensor fusion with 2D and 3D LiDAR.
* Planning and control: Path planning, trajectory following, and feedback control for mobile robots, with a strong grounding in kinematics.
* Simulation: Gazebo and NVIDIA Isaac Sim for robot simulation and sim-to-real validation.
* Programming: Strong C++ (C++17 or later) and Python.

SAIC is seeking a **Senior Electronics Engineer** to support the design, development, acquisition, and sustainment of U.S. Navy radar antenna systems and subsystems in **Crane, Indiana**. The selected candidate will be a key technical contributor for RF components, antennas, and apertures used in radar and electronic warfare (EW) systems.

This position will focus on designing, modeling, measuring, analyzing, simulating, and verifying RF performance of antenna systems and components, while providing technical antenna and aperture oversight to Program Acquisition Executives, design agents, and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).

Serve as senior electronics/RF engineer for U.S. Navy radar and EW antenna/aperture systems across the full life cycle (requirements, design, integration, test, sustainment).

Design, model, simulate, and analyze RF components and antenna elements/arrays (including feeds and RF circuitry) to meet performance and environmental requirements using tools such as MATLAB, C++, CST, HFSS or similar EM simulators.

Plan, conduct, and analyze RF measurements of antennas and apertures (gain, patterns, polarization, impedance, bandwidth, sidelobes) in lab, near‑field, and far‑field test environments using network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, near‑field scanners, and related equipment, ensuring data quality and repeatability.

Develop and apply expertise in electromagnetic performance characterization, antenna calibration, pattern correction, and near‑field range testing, including:

* Configuration and operation of near‑field scanners/positioners

  Instrument control and automation
* Near‑field to far‑field transformations

  Antenna pattern troubleshooting and diagnostics

  Participate in the design, prototyping, and verification of advanced antenna technologies, including evaluation of new materials and architectures for radar and EW applications.

  Provide technical oversight of antenna and aperture designs for Program Acquisition Executives, including review of OEM designs, test plans, and results for compliance with requirements and Navy standards.

  Collaborate with Program Executive Offices, government stakeholders, and OEMs to refine technical requirements, resolve technical issues, and guide trade studies.

  Develop and maintain technical documentation such as specifications, interface control documents, CDRLs, white papers, trade studies, test plans/procedures/reports, and status/technical review packages.

  Prepare and deliver technical presentations and briefings to customers, collaborators, and leadership, clearly communicating complex antenna/RF concepts, findings, and recommendations.

  Support formal design and test reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR), assessing antenna/RF risks, design margins, and verification strategies.

**Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a closely related discipline from an accredited institution.

5+ years of experience in RF/electronics engineering, with emphasis on antennas, apertures, or RF components for radar, EW, or similar high‑performance systems.

**Must be able to obtain a Secret Security Clearance - new hire can start with interim clearance.**

**Must be a United States citizen**

Experience with engineering software tools, including:

MathWorks MATLAB for data analysis and modeling

C++ or similar languages for algorithm implementation or automation

CST (or similar EM solvers such as HFSS, FEKO, etc.) for antenna/RF simulation

Conceptual knowledge of near‑field range testing, including near‑field to far‑field transformations and related antenna pattern validation techniques.

Conceptual knowledge of designing, prototyping, and verification of antenna technologies, including interpretation of test results and pattern discrepancies.

Ability to communicate effectively with Program Executive Offices and antenna system OEMs, including requirements clarification, technical issue resolution, and status reporting.

**Desired Qualifications**  
Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, RF Engineering, or related field.  
Direct experience with Navy radar or EW antenna systems, including shipboard or airborne radar apertures.

  
Target salary range: $100,001 - $140,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

new_jobs.description:
**Intermediate Electrical Engineer**

**McCoy Global**

**THIS JOB IS FOR YOU**

**IF YOU** ACT LIKE AN OWNER AND OWN YOUR ACTIONS;

**IF YOU** EMBRACE CHALLENGE AND LEAD CHANGE;

**IF YOU** EVOLVE, ADAPT AND CELEBRATE SUCCESS;

**IF YOU** APPROACH ALL INTERACTIONS POSTIVELY, COURAGEOULSY AND HONESTLY;

**IF YOU** HAVE YOUR TEAMS BACK;

**IF YOU** ARE THE BEST AT EVERYTHING YOU DO!

**What We Need:**

Are you passionate about creating innovative technology that performs in some of the world's toughest operating environments? We are seeking an **Intermediate Electrical Engineer** to help design, develop, and test embedded systems that power our industrial sensor and control products.

In this role, you'll work across the entire product development lifecycle, contributing from concept and prototyping through validation, testing, and production release. You'll apply your expertise in embedded hardware and firmware development to build reliable, high-performing solutions that enable our customers to operate safely and efficiently.

As part of a collaborative engineering team, you'll develop software for microcontrollers and microprocessors, contribute to electronic circuit design, troubleshoot complex technical challenges, and help bring new products to market. If you're a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and working on products that make a real impact in industrial environments, we'd like to hear from you.

**What you’ll bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in embedded systems development.

**What you’ll do:**

* Hands-on experience programming microcontrollers and microprocessors across common architectures.
* Solid programming skills in C and C++ for embedded applications.
* Working knowledge of common hardware interfaces and peripherals (timers, analog I/O, serial communication buses).
* Practical experience with firmware update and bootloader implementation for devices deployed in the field.
* Working knowledge of electronic circuit design, including power and signal basics.
* Applies low-power design considerations to battery operated devices.
* Uses standard lab and debugging equipment to independently troubleshoot hardware and software issues.
* Demonstrated experience with wireless or wired communication technologies.
* Applies product testing and compliance requirements to designs.
* Works with cross functional teams and contributes to project planning and code reviews.

**Who Are We?**

Over a century ago, blacksmith Henry McCoy established the Edmonton Auto Spring Works in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. Back in 1914, the name McCoy meant a commitment to quality; and that, along with a desire to continually innovate, is what we stand for today.

**KEEPING AHEAD OF THE CURVE**

Always ahead of the curve, we’ve evolved from auto springs, axle manufacturing, trucking, and trailers, to hydraulic power tongs, advanced engineering for wellbore integrity, data acquisition for harsh environments, and cloud-based automated Smart technology solutions. Our evolution has been relentless – just the way we love it.

**LEADING CHANGE**

All along the way, we have aggressively embraced change to support our customers at every turn, anticipating their needs and delivering highly customized solutions. It is no surprise that our company today bears little resemblance to the blacksmith shop of 1914.

**AN UNWAVERING FOCUS**

Yet it is also no surprise that our spirit remains fundamentally unchanged: our focus on quality and customization ensures the products and services we provide live up to our promises, so you can live up to yours.

**When you work at McCoy, you work with:**

* A great teamwork environment that challenges your ability while having fun.
* A voice to help us continuously improve our processes and teams.
* A chance to help us deliver innovative solutions to our customers provide energy to the world.
* An opportunity to grow within our company as we succeed in growing our customers.
* An organization that recognizes and cares about its employee’s well-being.

**So, what can McCoy offer you?**

* We offer competitive time-off
* 4 wellness days PER YEAR plus your birthday off!
* 3 weeks of vacation accrued throughout the year
* We match your 401K
* Matching Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Work with a company that CARES

**We are 1-McCoy and We want YOU!**

new_jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer
new_jobs.description:
As a **Senior Automation Engineer**, you will perform automation engineering activities in support of production machinery, proof of manufacturing automation and other activities, including machine controls, interfaces, programmable logic controllers (PLC’s), software, data tracking and other areas. You will design equipment stations and implement improvements. This role may also manage outsourced vendors involved in design projects.

**Why this role matters:**
--------------------------

Designing equipment stations and automating manufacturing steps means your ideas end up on the production floor, running real products at real volume. PLCs, machine controls, process validation, change management, and vendor management are valuable across manufacturing, medical devices, and industrial automation. This role is built for people who work independently and take ownership. You’ll lead cross-functional teams, mentor junior engineers, and tackle problems that don’t have textbook answers. Working with engineering, production, and business teams means you’ll develop the communication skills that move people into leadership. You’ll present to executives and explain complex technical work to non-technical audiences. The role contributes to process improvements, so your judgment and creativity shape how things get done, not just how they’re documented.

**In this role:**
-----------------

* Performs automation engineering activities in support of production machinery, manufacturing testing, and other activities, including machine controls, interfaces, PLCs, software, and data tracking
* Manages large-scale automation projects, planning work with outside vendors to build final products
* Analyzes manufacturing processes and steps, performs initial consumable process development, and develops plans to automate individual steps or entire processes
* Designs equipment stations and implements improvements
* Coordinates with other engineering, production, and business areas to integrate automation into the overall manufacturing process
* Manages outsourced vendors involved in design projects
* Performs work with no direct supervision, leads cross-functional project teams, and may supervise or mentor junior engineers
* Solves complex problems without routine solutions and contributes to process improvements
* Presents written reports and verbal presentations to line-of-business and executive management
* Travels occasionally and works in office, engineering lab, and industrial environments, including areas with machinery noise, electrical power, moving parts, and clean room or ESD controls

**What you need to succeed:**
-----------------------------

* A bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* Typically 5+ years of experience, including 2 years of CAD and 2 years of design experience
* Familiarity with PLCs, software, and related automation areas
* Experience with design verification/validation, process validation, and change management procedures
* Familiarity with supply chain and vendor interfaces
* Ability to read and interpret standards (such as ISO 9000), specifications, and technical procedures
* Ability to manage tasks and projects through to completion
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences
* Ability to work collaboratively on cross-functional teams
* Technical writing skills, including creating SOPs and work instructions
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Project) and other engineering software; working knowledge of SAP is preferred
* Physical ability to sit or stand for extended periods, lift up to 50 pounds, and occasionally climb, bend, kneel, or crouch

**What you can expect from us:**
--------------------------------

* Target salary ranging between $112, 000 - $116,000 annually
* Opportunity for annual cash bonus and merit pay increase consideration
* Health / Dental / Vision benefits from day one
* 5% matching 401k
* On-the-job training and career advancement opportunities
* Additional benefits including but not limited to financial support, pet insurance, mental health resources, volunteer paid days off, employee stock program, foundation donation matching, and more
The opportunity to do meaningful work where you positively impact the lives of people and pets all over the world

new_jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Autonomy Systems Engineering, Vehicle Control
new_jobs.description:
Motional is a leading autonomous driving company on a mission to make driverless vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. Backed by Hyundai Motor Group, Motional is at the forefront of the physical AI revolution. Motional isn't just building first-of-its-kind technology; we are transforming transportation to create safer streets and more sustainable mobility options.

The Systems Readiness and Performance team is the crucial bridge between software development and real-world deployment. We are responsible for driving system design, for verifying and validating the autonomy stack, and for defining, measuring, and validating system performance targets. We work closely with stakeholders in autonomy, vehicle platform, safety, infrastructure, and operations to build the safety case for our fully driverless IONIQ 5 robotaxis in Las Vegas and to shape the vehicle platform that comes next.

  

**Mission Summary:**

The vehicle control interface is where Motional's autonomy software interfaces with the vehicle platform: steering, braking, and propulsion commands go out, and actuator state, faults, and vehicle interventions come back. Gaps in requirements or test coverage at this boundary show up as issues on the road.

As a Senior Systems Engineer embedded with our vehicle control software team, you will own the verification and validation strategy for the vehicle interface software on our current fleet, act as the systems reviewer for changes going into releases, and contribute to the control interface requirements for our next-generation platform.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Build and own the verification and validation plan for the vehicle interface control software: catalog existing tests across unit, integration, simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, and test track; map them to requirements; and close coverage gaps.
* Establish an impact analysis process so every software change ships with the right regression tests identified and tracked.
* Review and approve changes to vehicle interface and fault handling logic as the systems engineering representative, defining the evidence needed for release.
* Analyze fleet and test data to characterize vehicle behavior (braking, traction and stability interventions, torque response) and turn findings into requirements and test cases.
* Draft and review control interface requirements for the next-generation platform alongside the principal engineer, and prepare technical material for discussions with Hyundai Motor Group.
* Support safety analyses on the vehicle control path and make sure the resulting requirements are testable.
* Build automated analysis and dashboards (Python, SQL) that give fast feedback on vehicle interface performance.
* Support root cause analysis of vehicle interface issues from testing and operations.
  

**What we're looking for:**

* BS in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, Robotics, Computer, or equivalent Engineering; MS preferred.
* 5+ years of engineering experience on safety-critical systems, including hands-on work bringing up or integrating a vehicle platform for an ADAS or automated driving system (vehicle interface, actuation, drive-by-wire control, or platform testing).
* End-to-end systems engineering experience: requirements, analysis, and verification and validation, including building test plans and tracking requirement-to-test coverage.
* Software or hardware test development experience.
* Strong analytical skills across vehicle dynamics, data analysis, and systems analysis.
* Python or similar, and SQL, for analyzing test and fleet data; ability to read C++.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; effective working day to day with a software development team.
* In-vehicle networking tools and signal definition with CAN
  

**Bonus points(not required):**

* Automotive functional safety or SOTIF experience (ISO 26262, ISO 21448) applied to control software.
* Hardware-in-the-loop test development.
* Requirements management and traceability tools (Jama, DOORS, Polarion, or similar).
* Experience working directly with an automaker or Tier 1 supplier on vehicle interfaces.
  

**Physical Demands:**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk, or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand and at times for long periods; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and move up to 50 pounds.

  

**Travel Requirements (up to 20%)**:

Expected to travel to our Las Vegas test site and to Pittsburgh for vehicle testing and integration, roughly 1-2 weeks each quarter, with occasional international travel as needed for the business.

  

**Working Environment:**

The work environment characteristics described here represent those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The team member is regularly exposed to mechanical and computer parts. The team member is occasionally exposed to fumes and/or airborne particles. The noise level in the environment is low to moderate.

*Motional AD LLC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified applicants. All applicants will receive impartial consideration without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic data, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation or other legally protected status. Motional AD LLC is a Drug-free workplace.*

new_jobs.title: Sr. Electrical Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Brady Corporation is seeking an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to join our Engineering team. In this role, you will lead the design and development of the circuit boards that control our industrial laser marking systems. You will take ownership of existing controller designs and help define the hardware for our next generation of products, working across the full development lifecycle from concept and design to testing, production, and ongoing support.

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or related field.
* 8+ years of experience designing PCBs for embedded or industrial products.
* Proficiency in schematic capture and PCB layout using Altium Designer; OrCAD/Allegro experience is a plus.
* Experience with high-speed digital and mixed-signal design, and with power circuits such as DC-DC converters.
* Knowledge of EMC/EMI design principles and circuit protection.
* Hands-on lab skills for board bring-up and debugging.
* Experience with safety circuits, motion control, or laser systems is a plus.

  
Req Benefits:

* Comprehensive insurance coverage starting on your first day of employment, including medical, dental, and vision
* Generous 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Opportunity to participate in incentive programs for all full-time employees
* Family planning benefits including paid parental leave, fertility coverage, adoption and surrogacy assistance
* Education reimbursement opportunities
* Scholarship program for children of Brady employees
* A variety of Employee Resource Groups to provide you with unique networking, development, and volunteer opportunities
* Employee Assistance Program and related wellness programs (mental and behavioral health, family counseling, financial management)
* Dress-for-your-day dress code
* Charitable contributions matched through Brady's Matching Gift program

  
Additional Details :

**Who we are:**  

Brady Corporation is a global industrial technology leader dedicated to making workplaces safer, more productive, and more connected. Backed by a 110+ year legacy of reliability and innovation, we have entered an exciting era of transformation and growth, powered by more than 10,000 team members serving customers across 40+ countries. Following our acquisition of Honeywell's Productivity Solutions and Services business in August 2026, Brady brings together trusted leadership in safety, materials science, and identification with advanced mobile computing, scanning, and automation.

We help organizations make work safer, more productive, and more connected by transforming everyday critical information into actionable intelligence. Our end-to-end platform unites two powerful pillars:

* Identification Solutions: High-performance labels, safety signs, engineered materials, and rugged industrial printing systems.
* Intelligent Productivity Solutions: Industry-leading mobile computers, barcode/RFID scanners, specialized software, voice automation, and workflow services.

From aerospace, healthcare, and laboratories to manufacturing plants, retail, data centers, and global transportation and logistics hubs, we empower customers to identify, protect, track, and optimize the people, assets, and processes that keep the world running.

**Why work at Brady:**  
A career at Brady means working for a global company that has thrived for over 100 years, and whose innovative spirit drives our future growth.

Brady offers competitive pay and great benefits, supported by a culture that encourages collaboration and innovation. We strive to foster an inclusive workplace where diverse talent can learn, grow, and succeed. And with deeply rooted values, no matter where you work at Brady, you'll feel connected to the community through our charitable contributions and opportunities to give back.

Our headquarters are in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, but we have more than 70 locations globally, giving our employees the opportunity to work with colleagues around the world.

**What You Need To Be Successful**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or related field.
* 8+ years of experience designing PCBs for embedded or industrial products.
* Proficiency in schematic capture and PCB layout using Altium Designer; OrCAD/Allegro experience is a plus.
* Experience with high-speed digital and mixed-signal design, and with power circuits such as DC-DC converters.
* Knowledge of EMC/EMI design principles and circuit protection.
* Hands-on lab skills for board bring-up and debugging.
* Experience with safety circuits, motion control, or laser systems is a plus.
